      function loadSettings() {
          try {
              const raw = _dbGet(CFG_KEY);
              if (!raw) return;
              const d = JSON.parse(raw);
              for (const e of _CFG_SCALARS) {
                  if (d[e.key] !== undefined) { e.set(d[e.key]); continue; }
                  if (e.migrate) {
                      for (const [oldKey, fn] of Object.entries(e.migrate)) {
                          if (d[oldKey] !== undefined) { fn(d[oldKey]); break; }
                      }
                  }
              }
              for (const [oldKey, newKey] of Object.entries(_CFG_FEAT_MIGRATIONS)) {
                  if (d[oldKey] !== undefined) _feats[newKey] = d[oldKey];
              }
              for (const [oldKey, newKey] of Object.entries(_CFG_SHOW_MIGRATIONS)) {
                  if (d[oldKey] !== undefined) _shows[newKey] = d[oldKey];
              }
              if (d.feats) Object.assign(_feats, d.feats);
              if (d.shows) { for (const k of Object.keys(_shows)) { if (d.shows[k] !== undefined) _shows[k] = d.shows[k]; } }
              if (d.snipeCfg) {
                  for (const mode of ['steal', 'waves']) {
                      if (d.snipeCfg[mode]) { const src = d.snipeCfg[mode]; for (const k of _SNIPE_KEYS) if (k in src) snipeCfg[mode][k] = src[k]; }
                  }
              } else {
                  const mig = {};
                  if (d.snipeFilter !== undefined) mig.filter = d.snipeFilter;
                  if (d.snipeAutoDrop !== undefined) mig.autoDrop = d.snipeAutoDrop;
                  if (d.snipeAutoSell !== undefined) mig.autoSell = d.snipeAutoSell;
                  if (d.snipeLockdownMax !== undefined) mig.lockdownMax = d.snipeLockdownMax;
                  if (d.snipeActive !== undefined) mig.active = d.snipeActive;
                  Object.assign(snipeCfg.steal, mig);
                  Object.assign(snipeCfg.waves, mig);
              }
              snipeCfg.steal.afkSell = false;
              snipeCfg.waves.afkSell = false;
              if (d.keybinds) Object.assign(KEYBINDS, d.keybinds);
              if (d.keyLabels) Object.assign(_keyLabels, d.keyLabels);
              _shows.settings = true;
          } catch (e) { _log('err', 'load cfg: ' + e.message); }
      }

      function _cached(ttl, fn, missTtl = Math.min(ttl, 250)) {
          let v = null, t = 0, hasHit = false;
          const get = () => {
              const n = Date.now();
              if (t && n - t < (hasHit ? ttl : missTtl)) return v;
              v = fn() || null;
              hasHit = v != null;
              t = n;
              return v;
          };
          get.clear = () => { v = null; t = 0; hasHit = false; };
          return get;
      }

          function capturePos(player) {
              const p = player.getPosition();
              const r = player.getEulerAngles();
              const camera = getCamera();
              const cam = camera?.getEulerAngles();
              let se = null;

                  if (inst.eulers) { se = vec3(inst.eulers); break; }

          }
          function restoreCam(posData) {

              const camera = getCamera();
              if (!camera) return;
              let scriptRestored = false;
              for (const inst of (camera.script?._scripts || [])) {
                  if ('_yaw' in inst) { inst._yaw = posData.cam.y; scriptRestored = true; }
                  if ('_pitch' in inst) { inst._pitch = posData.cam.x; scriptRestored = true; }
                  if ('yaw' in inst) { inst.yaw = posData.cam.y; scriptRestored = true; }
                  if ('pitch' in inst) { inst.pitch = posData.cam.x; scriptRestored = true; }
                  if (inst.eulers && posData.se) {
                      inst.eulers.x = posData.se.x; inst.eulers.y = posData.se.y; inst.eulers.z = posData.se.z;
                      scriptRestored = true;
                  }

          let _blinkLastMs = 0;
          function _blink() {
              const now = performance.now();
              if (snipeCfg.steal.active && now - _blinkLastMs < 1000) return;
              const p = getPlayer();

              const cam = getCamera();

          function keyCodeLabel(code) {
              if (_keyLabels[code]) return _keyLabels[code];
              if (code === 'Space') return 'Space';
              if (code.startsWith('Key')) return code.slice(3);
              if (code.startsWith('Digit')) return code.slice(5);
              if (code.startsWith('Numpad')) return 'Num' + code.slice(6);
              return code;
          }

                  firstPerson: T.kb_first_person,
              };
              let rows = '';
              const sorted = Object.entries(KEYBINDS).sort((a, b) => {
                  const la = (KB_LABELS[a[0]] || a[0]).toLowerCase();
                  const lb = (KB_LABELS[b[0]] || b[0]).toLowerCase();
                  return la < lb ? -1 : la > lb ? 1 : 0;
              });
              for (const [action, code] of sorted) {
                  rows += '<div class="ml-krow" data-action="' + action + '"><span class="ml-krow-action">' + (KB_LABELS[action] || action) + '</span><span class="ml-krow-key">' + keyCodeLabel(code) + '</span></div>';
              }

          function buildSlotsHTML() {
              const body = $('ml-slots-pop-body');
              if (!body) return;

                  const s = slots[i];

                  html += `<div class="ml-slot"><span class="ml-slot-num">${i}</span><span class="ml-slot-info${s ? ' filled' : ''}">${info}</span><button class="ml-slot-go${s ? '' : ' empty'}" data-slot="${i}">${T.go}</button><button class="ml-slot-set" data-slot="${i}">${T.set}</button><button class="ml-slot-clr${s ? '' : ' empty'}" data-slot="${i}">${T.close}</button></div>`;
              }

          slotsPop.addEventListener('click', e => {
              const goBtn = e.target.closest('.ml-slot-go');
              const setBtn = e.target.closest('.ml-slot-set');
              const clrBtn = e.target.closest('.ml-slot-clr');
              if (!goBtn && !setBtn && !clrBtn) return;
              const idx = parseInt((goBtn || setBtn || clrBtn).dataset.slot);
              if (isNaN(idx)) return;
              const p = getPlayer();
              if (!p) return;
              if (clrBtn) {
                  slots[idx] = null;
                  saveWaypoints();
                  flash('ml-slots');
                  buildSlotsHTML();
                  _clog(`[slot ${idx}] cleared`);
              } else if (setBtn) {
                  slots[idx] = capturePos(p);
                  saveWaypoints();
                  flash('ml-slots');
                  buildSlotsHTML();
                  _clog(`[slot ${idx}] saved via popout`);
              } else if (goBtn && slots[idx]) {
                  backPos = capturePos(p);
                  teleport(p, slots[idx]);
                  saveWaypoints();
                  flash('ml-slots');
                  toggleSlots(false);
                  _clog(`[slot ${idx}] teleported via popout`);
              }
          });

          const interactivePanels = [plist, settings, d, petsPanel, slotsPop, snipePanel];
          const stopPointerEvents = ['mousedown','mouseup','click','pointerdown','pointerup','mousemove','mouseover','mouseenter','mouseleave','wheel','contextmenu','pointermove','pointerover','pointerenter'];
          const stopKeyEvents = ['keydown','keyup','keypress'];

          interactivePanels.forEach(el => {

          function makeDraggable(panel, handle, storageKey) {
              let dragging = false, ox = 0, oy = 0;
              const SK = storageKey ? _pfx + 'p-' + storageKey : null;
              handle.style.cursor = 'grab';
              panel.style.resize = 'both';
              panel.style.overflow = 'auto';
              function clampToScreen() {
                  const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
                  const vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
                  let l = r.left, t = r.top;
                  if (r.width > vw) l = 0;
                  else { if (l + r.width > vw) l = vw - r.width; if (l < 0) l = 0; }
                  if (r.height > vh) t = 0;
                  else { if (t + r.height > vh) t = vh - r.height; if (t < 0) t = 0; }
                  panel.style.left = l + 'px';
                  panel.style.top = t + 'px';
                  panel.style.right = 'auto';
                  panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
                  panel.style.transform = 'none';
              }
              function savePos() {
                  if (!SK) return;
                  const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
                  if (!panel.style.left && !panel.style.top) return;
                  try { _dbSet(SK, JSON.stringify({ l: Math.round(r.left), t: Math.round(r.top), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height) })); } catch {}
              }
              function restorePos() {
                  if (!SK) return false;
                  const raw = _dbGet(SK);
                  if (!raw) return false;
                  try {
                      const p = JSON.parse(raw);
                      panel.style.left = p.l + 'px';
                      panel.style.top = p.t + 'px';
                      panel.style.right = 'auto';
                      panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
                      panel.style.transform = 'none';
                      if (p.w) panel.style.width = p.w + 'px';
                      if (p.h) panel.style.height = p.h + 'px';
                      clampToScreen();
                      return true;
                  } catch { return false; }
              }
              function startDrag(cx, cy, tag) {
                  if (tag === 'BUTTON' || tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'LABEL') return false;
                  dragging = true;
                  handle.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
                  const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
                  panel.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
                  panel.style.top = rect.top + 'px';
                  panel.style.right = 'auto';
                  panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
                  panel.style.transform = 'none';
                  ox = cx - rect.left;
                  oy = cy - rect.top;
                  return true;
              }
              let _dragRaf = null, _dragCX = 0, _dragCY = 0;
              function moveDrag(cx, cy) {
                  if (!dragging) return;
                  _dragCX = cx; _dragCY = cy;
                  if (_dragRaf) return;
                  _dragRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                      _dragRaf = null;
                      if (!dragging) return;
                      const ph = panel.offsetHeight || 40;
                      const pw = panel.offsetWidth || 40;
                      const vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;

          }

          function getPlayers() {
              const holder = _getEnemyHolder();
              const player = getPlayer();
              const playerPos = player?.getPosition();
              const results = [];
              for (const enemy of holder.children) {
                  if (typeof _isImmortalEntity === 'function' && _isImmortalEntity(enemy)) continue;
                  const pos = enemy.getPosition();
                  let username = _getEnemyName(enemy);
                  if (!username || username === 'Enemy') username = enemy.name !== 'Enemy' ? enemy.name : null;
                  if (!username) username = 'Player';
                  const dist = playerPos ? Math.floor(playerPos.distance(pos)) : '?';
                  results.push({ name: username, dist, pos: vec3(pos), entity: enemy });
              }
              results.sort((a, b) => (typeof a.dist === 'number' && typeof b.dist === 'number') ? a.dist - b.dist : 0);
              return results;
          }

          function buildOwnerMap() {
              const now = Date.now();
              if (_ownerMapCache && now - _ownerMapTime < 2000) return _ownerMapCache;
              const map = {};
              const myId = W.pc?.sessionId;
              if (myId) map[myId] = T.owner_yours || 'Yours';
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              if (nm?.sessionId && !map[nm.sessionId]) map[nm.sessionId] = T.owner_yours || 'Yours';
              const holder = _getEnemyHolder();
              if (holder) {
                  for (const child of holder.children) {
                      if (typeof _isImmortalEntity === 'function' && _isImmortalEntity(child)) continue;
                      let id = child.id || child.sessionId || child.playerId;
                      if (!id && child.script) {
                          for (const sk of Object.keys(child.script._scriptsIndex || {})) {
                              const inst = child.script[sk];

                              if (id) break;
                          }
                      }
                      if (!id) continue;
                      const name = _getEnemyName(child);
                      if (name && name !== 'Enemy') map[id] = name;
                  }
              }
              _ownerMapCache = map;
              _ownerMapTime = now;
              return map;
          }

          function getPetOwnerName(pet, ownerMap) {
              const ownerId = getPetOwnerId(pet);
              if (ownerId === false || ownerId == null) return T.owner_wild || 'Wild';

              return ownerId.length > 10 ? ownerId.substring(0, 8) + '…' : ownerId;
          }

          function getAllPets() {
              const now = Date.now();
              if (_petsSnapshotCache && now - _petsSnapshotAt < 120) return _petsSnapshotCache.slice();
              const pm = getPetsManager();
              if (!pm) {
                  _petsSnapshotCache = null;
                  _petsSnapshotAt = 0;
                  return [];
              }
              hookPetSpawn();
              const ownerMap = buildOwnerMap();
              const pets = [];
              const scan = (map, type) => {
                  if (!map) return;
                  const MUT_MAP = { 0: 'Default', 1: 'Default', 2: 'Golden', 3: 'Diamond', 4: 'Emerald', 5: 'Rainbow', 6: 'Galaxy', 10: 'Hacked' };
                  const MUT_IDS = { Default: 1, Golden: 2, Diamond: 3, Emerald: 4, Rainbow: 5, Galaxy: 6, Hacked: 10 };
                  map.forEach((pet, token) => {
                      const sd = petSpawnData.get(token);
                      const name = sd?.name || pet.name || String(token).substring(0, 8);
                      let mutation = sd?.mutation ?? '';
                      if (typeof mutation === 'number') mutation = MUT_MAP[mutation] || mutation;
                      if (mutation === 'Default' || mutation === 1) mutation = '';
                      let rarity = sd?.rarity ?? '';
                      let profit = sd?.profit ?? null;
                      if (!mutation) {
                          try {
                              if (pet[_SYM_PMUT]) { mutation = pet[_SYM_PMUT]; }
                              else {
                                  for (const [mn, mid] of Object.entries(MUT_IDS)) {
                                      if (mn === 'Default') continue;
                                      if (pet.findByName?.(`Mutation ${mn} Effect`) || pet.findByName?.(`Mutation ${mid} Effect`)) { mutation = mn; break; }
                                  }
                                  if (mutation) pet[_SYM_PMUT] = mutation;
                              }
                          } catch (e) { _log('err', 'pet mutation: ' + e.message); }
                      }
                      if (!rarity) {
                          try {
                              if (pet[_SYM_PRAR]) { rarity = pet[_SYM_PRAR]; }
                              else {
                                  const RARITIES = ['BASIC', 'RARE', 'EPIC', 'LEGENDARY', 'MYTHICAL', 'EXOTIC', 'SECRET', 'EXCLUSIVE', 'QUANTUM'];
                                  for (const r of RARITIES) {
                                      const node = pet.findByName?.(r);
                                      if (node && ('_enabled' in node ? node._enabled : node.enabled)) { rarity = r; break; }
                                  }
                                  if (rarity) pet[_SYM_PRAR] = rarity;
                              }
                          } catch (e) { _log('err', 'pet rarity: ' + e.message); }
                      }
                      if (!profit) {
                          try {
                              if (pet[_SYM_PVAL]) {
                                  profit = pet[_SYM_PVAL];
                              } else {
                                  const statsEl = pet.findByName?.('PetStats');
                                  if (statsEl) {
                                      const profitEl = statsEl.findByName?.('Profit') || statsEl.findByName?.('PetProfit');
                                      if (profitEl?.element?.text) {
                                          const m = profitEl.element.text.match(/\$\s*([\d,.]+)\s*([kmbtqsxi]*)/);
                                          if (m) {
                                              let v = parseFloat(m[1].replace(/,/g, ''));
                                              const suf = m[2]?.toLowerCase();
                                              if (suf === 'k') v *= 1e3;
                                              else if (suf === 'm') v *= 1e6;
                                              else if (suf === 'b') v *= 1e9;
                                              else if (suf === 't') v *= 1e12;
                                              else if (suf === 'q') v *= 1e15;
                                              else if (suf === 's') v *= 1e18;
                                              else if (suf === 'x') v *= 1e21;
                                              else if (suf === 'i') v *= 1e24;
                                              profit = v;
                                              if (profit > 0) pet[_SYM_PVAL] = profit;
                                          }
                                      }
                                  }
                              }
                          } catch (e) { _log('err', 'pet profit: ' + e.message); }
                      }
                      const pos = pet.getPosition ? pet.getPosition() : pet.position;
                      const price = pet.price ?? 0;
                      pets.push({
                          token,
                          name,
                          price,
                          income: profit ?? 0,
                          owner: getPetOwnerName(pet, ownerMap),
                          ownerId: getPetOwnerId(pet),
                          type,
                          mutation,
                          rarity,
                          isEgg: sd?.isEgg || false,
                          x: pos?.x ?? 0,
                          y: pos?.y ?? 0,
                          z: pos?.z ?? 0,
                      });
                  });
              };
              scan(pm.activePets, 'active');
              scan(pm.basePets, 'base');
              _petsSnapshotCache = pets;
              _petsSnapshotAt = now;
              return pets.slice();
          }

                  if (typeof bv === 'string') bv = bv.toLowerCase();

              });

          function esc(s) {
              return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
          }
          function numFmt(n) {
              if (!isFinite(n)) return '\u2014';
              if (n >= 999.95e12) return (n / 1e15).toFixed(1) + 'q';
              if (n >= 999.95e9) return (n / 1e12).toFixed(1) + 't';
              if (n >= 999.95e6) return (n / 1e9).toFixed(1) + 'b';
              if (n >= 999.95e3) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'm';
              if (n >= 999.95) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'k';
              return n % 1 === 0 ? String(n) : n.toFixed(1);
          }
          let _petFilterCompiledRaw = null;
          let _petFilterCompiledFn = null;
          function petMatchesFilter(p, raw) {
              if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return true;
              const text = [p.name, p.owner, p.mutation, p.rarity].join(' ').toLowerCase();
              if (_petFilterCompiledRaw !== raw || !_petFilterCompiledFn) {
                  const tokens = raw.match(/\(|\)|AND|OR|[^\s()]+/gi) || [];
                  function parseOr(i, haystack) {
                      let [result, j] = parseAnd(i, haystack);
                      while (j < tokens.length && tokens[j]?.toUpperCase() === 'OR') {
                          const [r2, j2] = parseAnd(j + 1, haystack);
                          result = result || r2;
                          j = j2;
                      }
                      return [result, j];
                  }
                  function parseAnd(i, haystack) {
                      let [result, j] = parseAtom(i, haystack);
                      while (j < tokens.length) {
                          const up = tokens[j]?.toUpperCase();
                          if (up === 'AND') { j++; if (j >= tokens.length) break; }
                          else if (up === 'OR' || tokens[j] === ')') break;
                          const [r2, j2] = parseAtom(j, haystack);
                          result = result && r2;
                          j = j2;
                      }
                      return [result, j];
                  }
                  function parseAtom(i, haystack) {
                      if (i >= tokens.length) return [false, i];
                      if (tokens[i] === '(') {
                          const [result, j] = parseOr(i + 1, haystack);
                          return [result, j < tokens.length && tokens[j] === ')' ? j + 1 : j];
                      }
                      const t = tokens[i].toLowerCase();
                      if (t.includes('*') || t.includes('%')) {
                          const parts = t.split(/[*%]+/).filter(Boolean);
                          if (parts.length === 0) return [true, i + 1];
                          let pos = 0;
                          for (const part of parts) {
                              const idx = haystack.indexOf(part, pos);
                              if (idx === -1) return [false, i + 1];
                              pos = idx + part.length;
                          }
                          return [true, i + 1];
                      }
                      return [haystack.includes(t), i + 1];
                  }
                  _petFilterCompiledRaw = raw;
                  _petFilterCompiledFn = (haystack) => {
                      try { return parseOr(0, haystack)[0]; } catch (_) { return haystack.includes(raw.toLowerCase()); }
                  };
              }
              return _petFilterCompiledFn(text);
          }

          let _snipeTimer = null;
          let _lastSnipeActive = true;

          function getOwnerLockdownSecs(ownerId) {
              if (!ownerId) return 0;
              const now0 = Date.now();
              const until0 = _serverLockdownUntil.get(ownerId);
              if (until0) {
                  const rem0 = (until0 - now0) / 1000;
                  if (rem0 > 1) return rem0;
                  _serverLockdownUntil.delete(ownerId);
              }
              const ldm = _getLockdownMgr();
              if (ldm?.lockedBases) {
                  const entry = ldm.lockedBases.get(ownerId);
                  if (entry) {
                      const remaining = (entry.endTime - Date.now()) / 1000;
                      return remaining > 1 ? remaining : 0;
                  }
              }
              if (_serverLockedSessions.has(ownerId)) {
                  const bm = _getBasesManager();
                  if (bm?.activeBases) {
                      for (const bd of bm.activeBases) {
                          if (bd.data?.sessionId !== ownerId) continue;
                          if (bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft > 1) return bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft;
                          const lb = bd.entity?.findByName?.('LockdownButton')?.script?.lockdownButton;
                          if (lb?.lockdownTimeLeft > 1) return lb.lockdownTimeLeft;
                          return 0;
                      }
                  }
                  return 0;
              }
              const bm = _getBasesManager();
              if (bm?.activeBases) {
                  for (const bd of bm.activeBases) {
                      if (bd.data?.sessionId !== ownerId) continue;
                      const lb = bd.entity?.findByName?.('LockdownButton')?.script?.lockdownButton;
                      if (lb) {
                          if (lb.isLockdownActive && lb.lockdownTimeLeft > 0) return lb.lockdownTimeLeft;
                          if (lb.lockdownTimeLeft > 0) return lb.lockdownTimeLeft;
                          return 0;
                      }
                      if (bd.data.lockdownActive && bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft > 0) return bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft;
                      if (bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft > 0) return bd.data.lockdownTimeLeft;
                      return 0;
                  }
              }
              return 0;
          }

          function _isRecentlySnipedBase(ownerId) {
              const now = Date.now();
              if (_recentlySnipedBases.size) {
                  for (const [k, v] of _recentlySnipedBases) {
                      if (!v || now - v.time > 60000) _recentlySnipedBases.delete(k);
                  }
                  if (_recentlySnipedBases.size > 256) {
                      const overflow = _recentlySnipedBases.size - 256;
                      const it = _recentlySnipedBases.keys();
                      for (let i = 0; i < overflow; i++) _recentlySnipedBases.delete(it.next().value);
                  }
              }
              const entry = _recentlySnipedBases.get(ownerId);
              if (!entry) return false;
              if (now - entry.time > 60000) { _recentlySnipedBases.delete(ownerId); return false; }
              const curLock = getOwnerLockdownSecs(ownerId);
              if (curLock <= 0) entry.seenUnlock = true;
              if (entry.lockAtEntry > 0 && entry.seenUnlock && curLock > 0) { _recentlySnipedBases.delete(ownerId); return false; }
              return true;
          }

          const _snipedPets = [];
          const SNIPE_HISTORY_CAP = 200;
          function recordSnipe(token) {
              _snipedPets.push({ token: String(token), time: Date.now() });
              while (_snipedPets.length > SNIPE_HISTORY_CAP) _snipedPets.shift();
              _pendingSnipeTokens.add(String(token));
          }
          function getSnipeTime(token) {
              const t = String(token);
              for (let i = _snipedPets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                  if (_snipedPets[i].token === t) return _snipedPets[i].time;
              }
              return 0;
          }

          function snipeScan() {

                              blocked++; _blockLock++;

                  if (isStealMode && _lowestSellableIncome !== null) {

                  }

                              if (!(p.ownerId in ownerLockCache)) ownerLockCache[p.ownerId] = getOwnerLockdownSecs(p.ownerId);

                          }

                              if (b.value !== a.value) return b.value - a.value;
                              if (a.dist !== b.dist) return a.dist - b.dist;
                          }

                      });
                      let html = '<table class="ml-snipe-tbl"><tr><th>' + esc(T.sniper_tbl_pet || 'Pet') + '</th><th>' + esc(T.sniper_tbl_owner || 'Owner') + '</th><th>' + esc(T.sniper_tbl_lock || 'Lock') + '</th></tr>';
                      for (const r of rows) {
                          const cls = r.lock <= 0 ? 'lock-0' : r.lock <= 10 ? 'lock-lo' : 'lock-hi';
                          const lockStr = r.lock <= 0 ? '\u2705' : r.lock === Infinity ? '\ud83d\udd12\u221e' : '\ud83d\udd12' + (r.lock >= 60 ? Math.floor(r.lock / 60) + 'm' + (Math.ceil(r.lock % 60) > 0 ? Math.ceil(r.lock % 60) + 's' : '') : Math.ceil(r.lock) + 's');
                          html += '<tr><td>' + esc(r.pet) + '</td><td>' + esc(r.owner) + '</td><td class="' + cls + '">' + lockStr + '</td></tr>';
                      }
                      html += '</table>';
                      if (cachedHtml !== html) {
                          typesEl.innerHTML = html;
                          _snipeTypesHtmlCache.set(typesEl, html);
                      }
                  }
              }
              return { matches, pets, isStealMode, totalPets: pets.length, visiblePets: isStealMode ? nameMatches.length : (wavesWildMatches ? wavesWildMatches.length : 0), minLockSecs: isFinite(_minLockedSecs) ? _minLockedSecs : null, blocked, notWorth, _bWild: _blockWild, _bActive: _blockActive, _bLock: _blockLock, _lowestIncome: _lowestSellableIncome, sample: nameMatches[0] ? { owner: nameMatches[0].owner, ownerId: nameMatches[0].ownerId, type: nameMatches[0].type } : null };
          }

          let _heldPetCleanup = null;

          let _afkSellDiag = 0;

          const _AFK_SELL_MAX_PENDING = 1;
          const _AFK_SELL_FIRST_TMO = 500;
          const _AFK_SELL_RETRY_TMO = 1500;
          const _AFK_SELL_COOLDOWN = 1250;
          function _afkSellTick() {
              _afkPoll();
              const _mode = _snipeMode();
              const _cfg = _sc();
              if (_mode !== 'waves' || !_cfg.afkSell) { if (_afkSellDiag !== 5) { _afkSellDiag = 5; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-skip-mode', { mode: _mode, afkSell: _cfg.afkSell }, 'debug'); } return; }

              if (_afkSellDiag === 2) { _afkSellDiag = 0; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-active', null, 'debug'); }

              if (_afkSellPending >= _AFK_SELL_MAX_PENDING) {
                  if (_afkSellDiag !== 6) { _afkSellDiag = 6; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-max-pending', { pending: _afkSellPending, max: _AFK_SELL_MAX_PENDING }, 'debug'); }
                  return;
              }
              if (_getEscapeTsunami()?.isHoldingPet) { if (_afkSellDiag !== 7) { _afkSellDiag = 7; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-holding', null, 'debug'); } return; }
              if (_afkSellDiag >= 6 && _afkSellDiag <= 8) _afkSellDiag = 0;
              const app = W.pc?.app;
              const player = getPlayer();
              if (!app || !player) { _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-no-app', { app: !!app, player: !!player }, 'debug'); return; }
              const pets = getAllPets();
              const wildPets = pets.filter(p => (p.owner === (T.owner_wild || 'Wild') || !p.ownerId) && p.type !== 'base');
              if (!wildPets.length) { if (_afkSellDiag !== 3) { _afkSellDiag = 3; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-no-wild', { total: pets.length }, 'debug'); } return; }
              const nonMatching = wildPets.filter(p => !petMatchesFilter(p, _cfg.filter));
              if (!nonMatching.length) { if (_afkSellDiag !== 4) { _afkSellDiag = 4; _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-all-match', { wild: wildPets.length, filter: _cfg.filter, wildSample: wildPets.slice(0,3).map(p => ({ name: p.name, income: p.income, price: p.price, owner: p.owner })) }, 'debug'); } return; }
              _afkSellDiag = 0;
              nonMatching.sort((a, b) => (b.price || b.income || 0) - (a.price || a.income || 0));
              const target = nonMatching[0];
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              const room = nm?.room;
              if (!room) { _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-no-room', null, 'debug'); return; }
              const rawSend = _rawSend(room);
              const sid = room.sessionId;
              const token = String(target.token);
              if (_afkSellTokens.has(token)) {
                  if (!_afkSellTokenDuped.has(token)) { _afkSellTokenDuped.add(token); _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-token-dupe', { token, name: target.name }, 'debug'); }
                  return;
              }
              _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-target', { name: target.name, token, income: target.income, price: target.price, rarity: target.rarity, mutation: target.mutation, x: Math.round(target.x), z: Math.round(target.z), nonMatchingCount: nonMatching.length, wildCount: wildPets.length });
              _afkSellTokens.add(token);
              _afkSellPending++;

              let _resolved = false;
              let _retried = false;
              const _fireBuy = () => { rawSend('holdPet', target.token); };
              const _beginBuy = () => {
                  _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-buy-fire', { token, name: target.name });
                  _fireBuy();
                  const _buyTime = Date.now();
                  if (_feats.ghostMode) _wavesGhostPos = { x: target.x, y: target.y + 0.5, z: target.z };
                  const _cleanup = (why) => {
                      if (_resolved) return;
                      _resolved = true;
                      clearTimeout(_retryTimer);
                      _sellUnsub();
                      _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-' + why, { token, name: target.name, pending: _afkSellPending - 1 });
                      _afkSellPending--;
                      _afkSellTokens.delete(token);
                      _afkSellTokenDuped.delete(token);
                      _wavesGhostPos = null;
                  };
                  const _retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                      if (!_retried) {
                          _retried = true;
                          _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-buy-retry', { token, name: target.name, elapsed: Date.now() - _buyTime });
                          _fireBuy();
                          setTimeout(() => _cleanup('timeout'), _AFK_SELL_RETRY_TMO);
                          return;
                      }
                      _cleanup('timeout');
                  }, _AFK_SELL_FIRST_TMO);
                  const _sellUnsub = room.onMessage('petHeld', msg => {
                      if (msg?.holderSessionId !== sid) return;
                      if (String(msg.petToken) !== token) {
                          _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-petheld-diff-token', { expected: token, got: String(msg.petToken) });
                          return;
                      }
                      if (_resolved) { _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-petheld-after-resolve', { token }); return; }
                      _resolved = true;
                      clearTimeout(_retryTimer);
                      _sellUnsub();
                      _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-petheld', { token, name: target.name, elapsed: Date.now() - _buyTime });
                      rawSend('sellPet');
                      _afkSellLastSellAt = Date.now();
                      rawSend('dropPet');
                      _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-sell-sent', { token, name: target.name });
                      _statsIncrement('afk_sold');
                      _afkSellPending--;
                      _afkSellTokens.delete(token);
                      _afkSellTokenDuped.delete(token);
                      _wavesGhostPos = null;
                  });
              };
              const _cooldownDelay = _afkSellLastSellAt ? Math.max(50, _AFK_SELL_COOLDOWN - (Date.now() - _afkSellLastSellAt)) : 50;
              _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-cooldown-delay', { delay: _cooldownDelay, sinceSell: _afkSellLastSellAt ? Date.now() - _afkSellLastSellAt : -1 });
              setTimeout(_beginBuy, _cooldownDelay);
          }

          function heldPetCleanupTick() {
              if (_snipeMode() !== 'waves') return;
              if (!_sc().active || _snipeDropInProgress || _ownDropPending) return;
              if (_afkSellActive || _afkSellPending > 0) {
                  _dbgLog('snipe', 'cleanup-afksell-skip', { afkSellActive: _afkSellActive, pending: _afkSellPending });
                  return;
              }
              const et = _getEscapeTsunami();
              if (!et?.isHoldingPet) return;
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              const room = nm?.room;
              if (!room) return;

              const pos = getPlayer()?.getPosition();
              if (pos) rawSend('p', { x: pos.x, y: pos.y, z: pos.z, w: 0 });
              rawSend('dropPet');
              _ownDropPending = true;
              const sid = room.sessionId;
              const timer = setTimeout(() => { _ownDropPending = false; unsub(); }, 2500);
              const unsub = room.onMessage('escapeTsunamiPetDropped', msg => {
                  if (msg?.holderSessionId !== sid) return;
                  clearTimeout(timer);
                  unsub();
                  _ownDropPending = false;
              });
              _log('snipe', 'held-pet cleanup: forced drop');
              _dbgLog('snipe', 'forced-drop');
          }

          function _scheduleSnipeTick() {
              _snipeTimer = setTimeout(() => { try { snipeTick(); } catch (e) { _dbgLog('snipe', 'tick-crash', { error: e?.message || String(e), stack: e?.stack ? String(e.stack).split('\n').slice(0,3).join(' | ') : null }); } if (_snipeTimer) _scheduleSnipeTick(); }, 80);
          }
          function startSnipe() {
              if (_snipeTimer) { clearTimeout(_snipeTimer); _snipeTimer = null; }
              if (!_snipeRoomJoinTime) _snipeRoomJoinTime = Date.now();
              _lastSnipeActive = true;

              _scheduleSnipeTick();
              if (!_heldPetCleanup) _heldPetCleanup = setInterval(heldPetCleanupTick, 3000);
          }
          function stopSnipe() {
              if (_afkSellPending > 0 || _afkSellTokens.size > 0) {
                  _dbgLog('snipe', 'afksell-stop-reset', { pending: _afkSellPending, tokens: _afkSellTokens.size });
                  _afkSellPending = 0;
                  _afkSellTokens.clear();
                  _afkSellTokenDuped.clear();
                  _afkSellDiag = 0;
                  _afkSellDiagTick = 0;
                  _afkSellLastSellAt = 0;
              }
              _snipePetActionActive = false;
              _snipeActionStartedAt = 0;
              _snipePreInvis = null;
              _snipePreInvisBeforeFly = false;
              _snipeDropInProgress = false;
              if (typeof _carry.forcedInvis !== 'undefined') _carry.forcedInvis = false;
              _dbgLog('snipe', 'snipe-stop');
              if (_snipeTimer) { clearTimeout(_snipeTimer); _snipeTimer = null; }
              if (_heldPetCleanup) { clearInterval(_heldPetCleanup); _heldPetCleanup = null; }
              if (_stealRetryTimer) { clearInterval(_stealRetryTimer); _stealRetryTimer = null; }
              if (_stealPollTimer) { clearInterval(_stealPollTimer); _stealPollTimer = null; }
              _snipeWasHolding = false;
              _snipeCooldown = 0;
              _preSnipePos = null;
              _preSnipeOwner = null;
              _wavesGhostPos = null;
              _usedSlots.clear();
              if (_afkPrevInvis !== undefined && !_afkPrevInvis) { _feats.invisible = false; _toggleInvisible(false); _updateInvisEffect(false); }
              _afkSellActive = false;
          }

          let _lastSnipePanelMode = undefined;

          function toggleSnipePanel(forceOpen) {
              const nextOpen = forceOpen == null ? !snipePanel.classList.contains('open') : !!forceOpen;
              _togglePanel(snipePanel, forceOpen, () => {

          $('ml-debug-copy')?.addEventListener('click', async e => {
              const btn = e.currentTarget;
              if (!btn) return;
              const prev = btn.textContent;
              const logs = _dbgSnapshot(200);
              const payload = logs.map(e => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n');
              let ok = false;
              let method = null;
              try {
                  if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
                      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload);
                      ok = true;
                      method = 'clipboard';
                  }
              } catch (_) {}
              if (!ok) {
                  try {
                      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
                      ta.value = payload;
                      ta.style.position = 'fixed';
                      ta.style.left = '-9999px';
                      document.body.appendChild(ta);
                      ta.focus();
                      ta.select();
                      ok = document.execCommand('copy');
                      document.body.removeChild(ta);
                      if (ok) method = 'execCommand';
                  } catch (_) {}
              }
              _dbgLog('debug', 'copy-buffer', { ok, method, count: logs.length });
              btn.textContent = ok ? (T.copy_ok || 'Copied') : (T.copy_failed || 'Copy Failed');
              setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = T.s_copy_json || prev || ''; }, 1200);
          });

          $('ml-keybinds-body').addEventListener('click', e => {

          window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
              if (!kbListeningRow) return;
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              e.stopImmediatePropagation();
              const action = kbListeningRow.dataset.action;
              if (!action || !(action in KEYBINDS)) return;
              if (e.code === 'Escape') {
                  kbListeningRow.classList.remove('listening');
                  kbListeningRow.querySelector('.ml-krow-key').textContent = keyCodeLabel(KEYBINDS[action]);
                  kbListeningRow = null;
                  return;
              }
              const prevCode = KEYBINDS[action];
              KEYBINDS[action] = e.code;
              _dbgLog('settings', 'keybind-change', { action, from: prevCode, to: e.code });
              if (e.key.length === 1) _keyLabels[e.code] = e.key.toUpperCase();
              kbListeningRow.querySelector('.ml-krow-key').textContent = keyCodeLabel(e.code);
              kbListeningRow.classList.remove('listening');
              kbListeningRow = null;
              saveSettings();
              updateHUDBadgeLabels();
              _clog('[keybind] ' + action + ' → ' + e.code);
          }, true);

          function updateHUDBadgeLabels() {
              const map = {
                  'ml-fly':  ['FLY', 'fly'],
                  'ml-invis': ['INVIS', 'invisible'],
                  'ml-lock': ['LOCK', 'autolock'],
                  'ml-cfg':  ['CFG', 'settings'],
                  'ml-help':  ['HELP', 'help'],
                  'ml-snipe-btn': ['SNIPE', 'snipe+snipeToggle'],
                  'ml-pets-btn': ['PETS', 'pets'],
                  'ml-tp':   ['CUDDLE', 'cuddle'],
                  'ml-tc':   ['TC', 'towerComplete'],
                  'ml-prv':  ['PRV', 'prv'],
              };
              const nativeKeyMap = { 'ml-fly': 'fly', 'ml-invis': 'invis', 'ml-lock': 'lock', 'ml-tc': 'tc', 'ml-cfg': 'cfg', 'ml-help': 'help', 'ml-snipe-btn': 'snipeBtn', 'ml-pets-btn': 'petsBtn', 'ml-tp': 'tp', 'ml-prv': 'prv' };
              for (const [id, [label, action]] of Object.entries(map)) {
                  if (_nativeHud) {
                      const k = nativeKeyMap[id];
                      const kl = k && _nativeHud[k]?._native?.keyLbl;
                      if (kl?.element) {
                          if (!action) kl.element.text = 'SH';
                          else if (action.includes('+')) kl.element.text = action.split('+').map(a => keyBadge(KEYBINDS[a])).join('');
                          else kl.element.text = keyBadge(KEYBINDS[action]);
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
          updateHUDBadgeLabels();

          function toggleHelp(forceOpen) {
              const nextOpen = forceOpen == null ? !d.classList.contains('open') : !!forceOpen;
              _togglePanel(d, forceOpen);
              _dbgLog('ui', nextOpen ? 'help-open' : 'help-close');
          }
          $('ml-help').addEventListener('click', () => { toggleHelp(); });
          $('ml-dialog-close').addEventListener('click', () => toggleHelp(false));
          const dlgBody = $('ml-dialog-body');
          if (dlgBody) dlgBody.addEventListener('wheel', e => { e.stopPropagation(); }, { passive: true });

          function enableTouchScroll(el) {
              el.addEventListener('touchstart', e => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
              el.addEventListener('touchmove',  e => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
              el.addEventListener('touchend',   e => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
          }
          [$('ml-dialog-body'), $('ml-plist-body'), $('ml-settings-body'),
           $('ml-pets-body'), $('ml-slots-pop-body'),
           $('ml-snipe-types'), $('ml-ban-body')].forEach(el => { if (el) enableTouchScroll(el); });
          const banBody = $('ml-ban-body');
          if (banBody) banBody.addEventListener('wheel', e => { e.stopPropagation(); }, { passive: true });
          if (_ban.pending) { _ban.pending = false; _showBanVpnDialog(); }
      }
      function keyBadge(code) {
          if (_keyLabels[code]) return _keyLabels[code];
          if (code.startsWith('Key')) return code.slice(3);
          if (code.startsWith('Digit')) return code.slice(5);
          if (code.startsWith('Numpad')) { const r = code.slice(6); return r.length <= 2 ? 'N' + r : r.slice(0, 3); }
          if (code.startsWith('Shift')) return 'SH';
          if (code.startsWith('Control')) return 'CT';
          if (code.startsWith('Alt')) return 'ALT';
          if (code === 'Space') return 'SPC';
          if (code === 'Backquote') return '`';
          if (code === 'Escape') return 'ESC';
          if (code === 'Enter') return 'RET';
          if (code === 'Tab') return 'TAB';
          if (code === 'PageDown') return 'PgDn';
          if (code === 'PageUp') return 'PgUp';
          return code.length <= 3 ? code : code.slice(0, 3);
      }

      let _nativeHud = null;
      let _overlayMgr = null;
      function createNativeHUD() {
          const app = W.pc?.app;
          const pc = W.pc;
          if (!app || !pc) return null;
          const roundedTex = app.assets.get(236692532);
          const fontAsset = app.assets.get(236690804);
          const gpm = app.root.findByName('GamePlayMenu');
          if (!gpm || !roundedTex || !fontAsset) return null;

          const old = app.root.findByName('ML-HUD');
          if (old) old.destroy();

          const btnSize = 50, spacing = 56, rowGap = 68;
          const topLeftNudge = Math.round(btnSize * 0.12);
          const COL_NORM = [0.071, 0.071, 0.071];
          const COL_ON = [0, 0.5, 1];
          const COL_FRESH = [0, 0.66, 1];
          const COL_DISABLED = [0.071, 0.071, 0.071];

          const topDefs = [];
          if (!isMobile) {
              topDefs.push(['fly',  T.hb_fly, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.fly), 'ml-fly']);
          }
          topDefs.push(
              ['invis',   T.hb_inv, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.invisible), 'ml-invis'],
              ['lock', T.hb_lck,   keyBadge(KEYBINDS.autolock), 'ml-lock'],
          );
          if (isMobile) {
              topDefs.push(
                  ['slots', 'SLOTS', null, 'ml-slots'],
              );
          }
          topDefs.push(['prv', 'PRV', keyBadge(KEYBINDS.prv), 'ml-prv']);
          const botDefs = [
              ['tc',      'TC',  keyBadge(KEYBINDS.towerComplete), 'ml-tc'],
              ['cfg',     T.hb_cfg, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.settings), 'ml-cfg'],
              ['help',    T.hb_help,   keyBadge(KEYBINDS.help), 'ml-help'],
              ['snipeBtn',T.hb_snp, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.snipe) + keyBadge(KEYBINDS.snipeToggle), 'ml-snipe-btn'],
              ['petsBtn', T.hb_pet, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.pets), 'ml-pets-btn'],
              ['tp',      T.hb_cud, keyBadge(KEYBINDS.cuddle), 'ml-tp'],
          ];

          const mlGroup = new pc.Entity();
          mlGroup.addComponent('element', { type: 'group', anchor: [0,1,0,1], pivot: [0,1], width: 440, height: 200 });
          mlGroup.setLocalPosition(5, 0, 0);
          mlGroup.enabled = false;

          function _renderLblTex(text) {
              const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
              const s = 2;
              canvas.width = btnSize * s; canvas.height = btnSize * s;
              const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
              const fs = text.length > 3 ? 15 : text.length > 2 ? 20 : text.length > 1 ? 24 : 30;
              ctx.font = `bold ${fs * s}px system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif`;
              ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'black'; ctx.lineWidth = fs * s * 0.08;
              ctx.strokeText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
              ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
              ctx.fillText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
              const tex = new pc.Texture(app.graphicsDevice, { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height, mipmaps: false, magFilter: pc.FILTER_LINEAR, minFilter: pc.FILTER_LINEAR });
              tex.setSource(canvas);
              return tex;
          }

          function makeBtn(id, label, keyText, idx, yBase) {
              const btn = new pc.Entity();
              btn.addComponent('element', { type: 'group', anchor: [0,1,0,1], pivot: [0,1], width: btnSize + 6, height: btnSize + 30 });
              btn.setLocalPosition(idx * spacing, -yBase, 0);

              const bg = new pc.Entity('BG');
              bg.addComponent('element', {
                  type: 'image', anchor: [.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot: [.5,.5],
                  width: btnSize, height: btnSize,
                  color: new pc.Color(COL_NORM[0], COL_NORM[1], COL_NORM[2]),
                  opacity: 1, textureAsset: roundedTex.id, useInput: true
              });
              btn.addChild(bg);

              const lbl = new pc.Entity('Label');
              lbl.addComponent('element', {
                  type: 'image', anchor: [.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot: [.5,.5],
                  width: btnSize * 0.9, height: btnSize * 0.9, opacity: 1, useInput: false
              });
              lbl.element.texture = _renderLblTex(label);
              lbl[_SYM_LTXT] = label;
              bg.addChild(lbl);

              if (keyText && !isMobile) {
                  const isLong = keyText.length > 2, isMed = keyText.length === 2;
                  if (isLong || isMed) {
                      const hg = isLong ? 6 : 3, rw = hg * 2 + 0.5;
                      const dk = new pc.Entity('DesktopKey');
                      dk.addComponent('element', { type:'group', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5], width:25, height:25 });
                      dk.setLocalPosition(17.5, -17.5, 0);
                      bg.addChild(dk);
                      [[-hg,25,25],[hg,25,25],[0,rw,25]].forEach(([x,w,h],j)=>{
                          const e = new pc.Entity('Image');
                          const c = { type:'image', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5], width:w, height:h, color:new pc.Color(.388,.388,.388), opacity:1 };
                          if (j < 2) c.textureAsset = roundedTex.id;
                          e.addComponent('element', c); if (x) e.setLocalPosition(x,0,0); dk.addChild(e);
                      });
                      [[-hg,20,20],[hg,20,20],[0,rw,20]].forEach(([x,w,h],j)=>{
                          const e = new pc.Entity('Group');
                          const c = { type:'image', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5], width:w, height:h, color:new pc.Color(1,1,1), opacity:1 };
                          if (j < 2) c.textureAsset = roundedTex.id;
                          e.addComponent('element', c); if (x) e.setLocalPosition(x,0,0); dk.addChild(e);
                      });
                      const kl = new pc.Entity('Text');
                      kl.addComponent('element', { type:'text', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5],
                          text:keyText, fontSize:15, fontAsset:fontAsset.id, color:new pc.Color(0,0,0), autoWidth:true, autoHeight:true });
                      kl.setLocalPosition(0, -0.3, 0); dk.addChild(kl);
                  } else {
                      const dk = new pc.Entity('DesktopKey');
                      dk.addComponent('element', { type:'image', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5],
                          width:25, height:25, color:new pc.Color(.388,.388,.388), opacity:1, textureAsset:roundedTex.id });
                      dk.setLocalPosition(17.5, -17.5, 0);
                      bg.addChild(dk);
                      const inner = new pc.Entity('Group');
                      inner.addComponent('element', { type:'image', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5],
                          width:20, height:20, color:new pc.Color(1,1,1), opacity:1, textureAsset:roundedTex.id });
                      dk.addChild(inner);
                      const kl = new pc.Entity('Text');
                      kl.addComponent('element', { type:'text', anchor:[.5,.5,.5,.5], pivot:[.5,.5],
                          text:keyText, fontSize:15, fontAsset:fontAsset.id, color:new pc.Color(0,0,0), autoWidth:true, autoHeight:true });
                      kl.setLocalPosition(0.6, 0, 0); dk.addChild(kl);
                  }
              }

              mlGroup.addChild(btn);
              return { bg, lbl, btn, keyLbl: keyText ? btn.findByName('Text') : null };
          }

          let realign = () => {};
          let _chatEntity = null;
          let _origChatY = 0;

          function makeProxy(parts, htmlId) {
              const st = {};
              const setCol = (r, g, b) => { if (parts.bg.element) { parts.bg.element.color = new pc.Color(r, g, b); } };
              const update = () => {
                  if (!parts.bg.element || !parts.lbl.element) return;
                  if (st.disabled) {
                      parts.btn.enabled = false;
                      realign();
                      return;
                  }
                  if (!parts.btn.enabled) { parts.btn.enabled = true; realign(); }
                  if (st.fresh) {
                      setCol(COL_FRESH[0], COL_FRESH[1], COL_FRESH[2]);
                      parts.bg.element.opacity = 1;
                      parts.lbl.element.color = new pc.Color(1, 1, 1);
                  } else if (st.on) {
                      setCol(COL_ON[0], COL_ON[1], COL_ON[2]);
                      parts.bg.element.opacity = 1;
                      parts.lbl.element.color = new pc.Color(1, 1, 1);
                  } else {
                      setCol(COL_NORM[0], COL_NORM[1], COL_NORM[2]);
                      parts.bg.element.opacity = 1;
                      parts.lbl.element.color = new pc.Color(1, 1, 1);
                  }
              };
              return {
                  _native: parts,
                  classList: {
                      toggle(cls, force) { st[cls] = force; update(); },
                      add(cls) { st[cls] = true; update(); },
                      remove(cls) { delete st[cls]; update(); },
                      contains(cls) { return !!st[cls]; }
                  },
                  set textContent(t) {
                      if (!parts.lbl?.element) return;
                      const short = t.replace(/^SLOTS\s*/, '').replace(/^\u{1F512}\s*/u, '').replace(/^\u{1F513}\s*/u, '');
                      const txt = short.length > 5 ? short.substring(0, 5) : short;
                      if (parts.lbl[_SYM_LTXT] === txt) return;
                      parts.lbl[_SYM_LTXT] = txt;
                      const oldTex = parts.lbl.element.texture;
                      parts.lbl.element.texture = _renderLblTex(txt);
                      if (oldTex) oldTex.destroy();
                  },
                  get textContent() { return parts.lbl?.[_SYM_LTXT] || ''; },
                  addEventListener() {},
                  click() { const el = _sr.querySelector('.' + htmlId); if (el) el.click(); }
              };
          }

          const result = { _root: mlGroup, _renderLblTex };
          topDefs.forEach(([key, label, keyText, htmlId], i) => {
              result[key] = makeProxy(makeBtn(key, label, keyText, i, 0), htmlId);
          });
          botDefs.forEach(([key, label, keyText, htmlId], i) => {
              result[key] = makeProxy(makeBtn(key, label, keyText, i, rowGap), htmlId);
          });
          const topKeys = topDefs.map(d => d[0]);
          const botKeys = botDefs.map(d => d[0]);
          let _isPaused = false;
          realign = () => {
              const nudge = _isPaused ? 0 : topLeftNudge;
              let ti = 0;
              for (const k of topKeys) {
                  if (!result[k]?._native?.btn?.enabled) continue;
                  const topY = nudge;
                  result[k]._native.btn.setLocalPosition(ti * spacing, topY, 0);
                  btnLayout[k].idx = ti;
                  btnLayout[k].yBase = -topY;
                  ti++;
              }
              const topRowVisible = ti > 0;
              const botBaseY = topRowVisible ? -rowGap : 0;
              const botY = botBaseY + nudge;
              let bi = 0;
              for (const k of botKeys) {
                  if (!result[k]?._native?.btn?.enabled) continue;
                  result[k]._native.btn.setLocalPosition(bi * spacing, botY, 0);
                  btnLayout[k].idx = bi;
                  btnLayout[k].yBase = -botY;
                  bi++;
              }
              if (_chatEntity) {
                  if (_isPaused) {
                      _chatEntity.setLocalPosition(_chatEntity.localPosition.x, _origChatY, 0);
                  } else {
                      const baseOffset = Math.abs(mlGroup.localPosition.y);
                      const visibleRows = (ti > 0 ? 1 : 0) + (bi > 0 ? 1 : 0);
                      const chatY = visibleRows === 0
                          ? _origChatY
                          : -(baseOffset + _gameTopOffset + 60 + 12);
                      _chatEntity.setLocalPosition(_chatEntity.localPosition.x, chatY, 0);
                  }
              }
          };
          if (result.tc?._native?.btn) result.tc._native.btn.enabled = false;

          const prevOverlay = $('ml-click-overlay');
          if (prevOverlay) prevOverlay.remove();
          const clickOverlay = document.createElement('div');
          clickOverlay.classList.add('ml-click-overlay');
          clickOverlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:none';
          _sr.appendChild(clickOverlay);
          const clickDivs = {};
          for (const key of Object.keys(result)) {
              const div = document.createElement('div');
              div.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation';
              div.dataset.key = key;
              clickOverlay.appendChild(div);
              clickDivs[key] = div;
          }
          ['mousedown','mouseup','pointerdown','pointerup'].forEach(evt => {
              clickOverlay.addEventListener(evt, e => {
                  if (e.target.dataset?.key) e.stopPropagation();
              });
          });
          clickOverlay.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
              if (e.target.dataset?.key) { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); }
          });
          clickOverlay.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
              const key = e.target.dataset?.key;
              if (key && result[key]) {
                  e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
                  _log('info', 'btn-touch ' + key);
                  _dbgLog('ui', 'btn-touch', { key }, 'debug');
                  result[key].click();
              }
          });
          clickOverlay.addEventListener('click', e => {
              const key = e.target.dataset?.key;
              if (!key || !result[key]) return;
              _log('info', 'btn-click ' + key);
              _dbgLog('ui', 'btn-click', { key }, 'debug');
              e.stopPropagation();
              e.preventDefault();
              result[key].click();
          });

          const btnLayout = {};
          topDefs.forEach(([key], i) => { btnLayout[key] = { idx: i, yBase: 0 }; });
          botDefs.forEach(([key], i) => { btnLayout[key] = { idx: i, yBase: rowGap }; });
          realign();

          let _syncDiag = false;
          let _syncLast = 0;
          let _syncTimer = null;
          const _overlayCssCache = {};
          function syncOverlay(force) {
              const now = performance.now();
              const syncDelay = document.hidden ? 1500 : 500;
              if (!force && now - _syncLast < syncDelay) {
                  clearTimeout(_syncTimer);
                  _syncTimer = setTimeout(() => syncOverlay(), Math.max(0, syncDelay - (now - _syncLast)));
                  return;
              }
              _syncLast = now;
              const canvas = app.graphicsDevice.canvas;
              const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
              const cw = rect.width, ch = rect.height;
              const scr = mlGroup.parent?.screen;
              const refW = scr?.referenceResolution?.x || 1280;
              const refH = scr?.referenceResolution?.y || 720;
              const sx = cw / refW, sy = ch / refH;
              const blend = scr?.scaleBlend ?? 0.5;
              const scale = Math.pow(sx, 1 - blend) * Math.pow(sy, blend);
              const groupY = Math.abs(mlGroup.localPosition.y);
              const groupX = mlGroup.localPosition.x;
              const visible = mlGroup.enabled;
              for (const key of Object.keys(result)) {
                  const lay = btnLayout[key];
                  if (!lay) continue;
                  const bgLeft = groupX + lay.idx * spacing + 3;
                  const bgTop  = groupY + lay.yBase + 15;
                  const div = clickDivs[key];
                  const nextLeft = (rect.left + bgLeft * scale) + 'px';
                  const nextTop = (rect.top  + bgTop  * scale) + 'px';
                  const nextWidth = (btnSize * scale) + 'px';
                  const nextHeight = (btnSize * scale) + 'px';
                  const nextDisplay = (visible && result[key]?._native?.btn?.enabled) ? 'block' : 'none';
                  const cache = _overlayCssCache[key] || (_overlayCssCache[key] = {});
                  if (cache.left !== nextLeft) { div.style.left = nextLeft; cache.left = nextLeft; }
                  if (cache.top !== nextTop) { div.style.top = nextTop; cache.top = nextTop; }
                  if (cache.width !== nextWidth) { div.style.width = nextWidth; cache.width = nextWidth; }
                  if (cache.height !== nextHeight) { div.style.height = nextHeight; cache.height = nextHeight; }
                  if (cache.display !== nextDisplay) { div.style.display = nextDisplay; cache.display = nextDisplay; }
              }
              if (!_syncDiag && visible) {
                  _syncDiag = true;
                  _log('setup', 'overlay-sync scale=' + scale.toFixed(3) + ' groupXY=' + groupX + ',' + groupY + ' canvas=' + cw.toFixed(0) + 'x' + ch.toFixed(0) + ' buttons=' + Object.keys(btnLayout).join(','));
                  _dbgLog('setup', 'overlay-sync', { scale: +scale.toFixed(3) }, 'debug');
              }
              clearTimeout(_syncTimer);
              _syncTimer = setTimeout(() => syncOverlay(), syncDelay);
          }

          const overlay = gpm.parent;
          overlay.addChild(mlGroup);

          overlay.screen.on('set:resolution', () => {
              _syncLast = 0;
              if (_isPaused) mlGroup.setLocalPosition(5, _pauseBottomY(), 0);
              syncOverlay(true);
          });

          syncOverlay(true);

          const _gameTopOffset = rowGap + btnSize + 20;
          const _pushedChildren = [];
          const _btnAreaBottom = -(_gameTopOffset + 5);
          const omArr = app.root.find(e => e.script?.overlayManager);
          const omScr = omArr?.[0]?.script?.overlayManager;
          if (omScr) _overlayMgr = omScr;
          const _noPush = new Set();
          if (omScr) {
              ['tabEntity','tabSlotHolder','tabButtonEntity','pauseEntity','deathScreenEntity','maintenanceComingOverlay','deathCountdownFill'].forEach(k => { if (omScr[k]) _noPush.add(omScr[k]); });
          }
          const _emoteMgr = app.root.find(e => e.script?.emotesManager)?.[0]?.script?.emotesManager;
          if (_emoteMgr?.popupEntity) _noPush.add(_emoteMgr.popupEntity);
          const _allOverlays = app.root.find(e => e.script?.overlayManager || e.script?.petTycoonOverlay || e.script?.escapeTsunamiOverlay || e.script?.towerParkourOverlay) || [];
          for (const child of gpm.children) {
              if (!child.element) continue;
              if (_noPush.has(child)) continue;
              const y = child.localPosition.y;
              if (y < _btnAreaBottom) continue;
              const origY = y;
              child.setLocalPosition(child.localPosition.x, origY - _gameTopOffset, 0);
              _pushedChildren.push({ entity: child, origY });
          }
          const chatEntity = gpm.findByName('Chat')
              || omScr?.chatMainHolder || omScr?.chatHolder
              || _allOverlays.reduce((f, e) => f || e.script?.petTycoonOverlay?.chatMainHolder || e.script?.escapeTsunamiOverlay?.chatMainHolder || e.script?.towerParkourOverlay?.chatMainHolder, null)
              || _allOverlays.reduce((f, e) => f || e.script?.petTycoonOverlay?.chatHolder || e.script?.escapeTsunamiOverlay?.chatHolder || e.script?.towerParkourOverlay?.chatHolder, null);
          if (chatEntity && !_pushedChildren.some(p => p.entity === chatEntity) && chatEntity.element) {
              const _cOrigY = chatEntity.localPosition.y;
              chatEntity.setLocalPosition(chatEntity.localPosition.x, _cOrigY - _gameTopOffset, 0);
              _pushedChildren.push({ entity: chatEntity, origY: _cOrigY });
          }
          const _chatPushed = chatEntity && _pushedChildren.some(p => p.entity === chatEntity);

          if (chatEntity) {
              _origChatY = _chatPushed
                  ? _pushedChildren.find(p => p.entity === chatEntity).origY
                  : chatEntity.localPosition.y;
              _chatEntity = chatEntity;
              const chatY = -(Math.abs(mlGroup.localPosition.y) + _gameTopOffset + 60 + 12);
              chatEntity.setLocalPosition(chatEntity.localPosition.x, chatY, 0);
          }

          const _mobileKeys = app.root.findByTag('MobileKey') || [];
          const _mobileTouch = app.root.find(e => e.script?.mobileTouch);
          if (_mobileTouch) _mobileKeys.push(_mobileTouch);
          for (const mk of _mobileKeys) {
              if (!mk?.localPosition || !mk.element) continue;
              if (_pushedChildren.some(p => p.entity === mk)) continue;
              const _mkOrigY = mk.localPosition.y;
              mk.setLocalPosition(mk.localPosition.x, _mkOrigY - _gameTopOffset, 0);
              _pushedChildren.push({ entity: mk, origY: _mkOrigY });
          }

          const pauseEntity = overlay.findByName('Pause');

          function _pauseBottomY() {
              const scr = overlay.screen;
              return -(scr.resolution.y / scr.scale - (rowGap + btnSize + 30));
          }
          function setPauseLayout() {
              _isPaused = true;
              mlGroup.setLocalPosition(5, _pauseBottomY(), 0);
              for (const p of _pushedChildren) p.entity.setLocalPosition(p.entity.localPosition.x, p.origY, 0);
              _syncLast = 0;
              realign();
              syncOverlay(true);
          }

          function setGameplayLayout() {
              _isPaused = false;
              mlGroup.setLocalPosition(5, 0, 0);
              for (const p of _pushedChildren) p.entity.setLocalPosition(p.entity.localPosition.x, p.origY - _gameTopOffset, 0);
              _syncLast = 0;
              realign();
              syncOverlay(true);
          }
          if (pauseEntity) {

const _K_STATS = _pfx + 'stats';

const _statsDefaults = {
  session_halos_stolen: 0,
  session_stolen_value: 0,
  session_steal_attempted: 0,
  session_waves_attempted: 0,
  session_eggs_sniped: 0,
  session_tower_clears: 0,
  session_pets_dropped: 0,
  lifetime_halos_stolen: 0,
  lifetime_stolen_value: 0,
  lifetime_steal_attempted: 0,
  lifetime_waves_attempted: 0,
  lifetime_eggs_sniped: 0,
  lifetime_tower_clears: 0,
  lifetime_pets_dropped: 0,
  session_start_time: Date.now(),
};

function _statsGet() {
  try {
    const raw = _dbGet(_K_STATS);
    if (!raw) return { ..._statsDefaults };
    return { ..._statsDefaults, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  } catch {
    return { ..._statsDefaults };
  }
}

function _statsSave(data) {
  try {
    _dbSet(_K_STATS, JSON.stringify(data));
  } catch {}
}

function _statsIncrement(key, amount = 1) {
  const data = _statsGet();
  const sessionKey = key.startsWith('session_') ? key : 'session_' + key;
  const lifetimeKey = 'lifetime_' + (key.startsWith('session_') ? key.replace('session_', '') : key);
  if (sessionKey in data) {
    data[sessionKey] = (data[sessionKey] || 0) + amount;
  }
  if (lifetimeKey in data) {
    data[lifetimeKey] = (data[lifetimeKey] || 0) + amount;
  }
  _statsSave(data);
}

function _statsSet(key, value) {
  const data = _statsGet();
  if (key in data) {
    data[key] = value;
    _statsSave(data);
  }
}

function _statsReset() {
  _statsSave({ ..._statsDefaults, session_start_time: Date.now() });
}

function _statsSessionReset() {
  const data = _statsGet();
  Object.keys(_statsDefaults).forEach(k => {
    if (k.startsWith('session_')) {
      data[k] = k === 'session_start_time' ? Date.now() : 0;
    }
  });
  _statsSave(data);
}

function _formatStatValue(val) {
  if (typeof val !== 'number') return String(val);
  if (val >= 1e15) return (val / 1e15).toFixed(1) + 'q $';
  if (val >= 1e12) return (val / 1e12).toFixed(1) + 't $';
  if (val >= 1e9) return (val / 1e9).toFixed(1) + 'b $';
  if (val >= 1e6) return (val / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'm $';
  if (val >= 1000) return (val / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k $';
  return val + ' $';
}

function _formatTime(ms) {
  const sec = Math.floor((ms / 1000) % 60);
  const min = Math.floor((ms / 60000) % 60);
  const hr = Math.floor(ms / 3600000);
  if (hr > 0) return hr + 'h ' + min + 'm';
  if (min > 0) return min + 'm ' + sec + 's';
  return sec + 's';
}

function _buildStatsHTML() {
  const stats = _statsGet();
  const nm = _getNetworkManager();
  const room = nm?.room;
  const snipeMode = _snipeMode();
  const isTower = room?.name === 'TowerParkour';
  const isSteal = snipeMode === 'steal';
  const isWaves = snipeMode === 'waves';
  const isHub = !snipeMode && !isTower;
  const modeLabel = isSteal ? T.stats_mode_steal : isWaves ? T.stats_mode_waves : isTower ? T.stats_mode_tower : T.stats_mode_hub;

  const row = (label, sess, life) =>
    `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 1fr;gap:2px 6px;margin-bottom:1px">`+
    `<div style="color:#ddd">${label}</div><div>${sess}</div><div>${life}</div></div>`;

  const rows = [
    isSteal && row(T.stats_row_halos, stats.session_halos_stolen, stats.lifetime_halos_stolen),
    isSteal && row(T.stats_row_attempts, stats.session_steal_attempted, stats.lifetime_steal_attempted),
    isSteal && row(T.stats_row_value, _formatStatValue(stats.session_stolen_value), _formatStatValue(stats.lifetime_stolen_value)),
    isWaves && row(T.stats_row_attempts, stats.session_waves_attempted, stats.lifetime_waves_attempted),
    isWaves && row(T.stats_row_eggs, stats.session_eggs_sniped, stats.lifetime_eggs_sniped),
    isWaves && row(T.stats_row_drops, stats.session_pets_dropped, stats.lifetime_pets_dropped),
    isTower && row(T.stats_row_tower, stats.session_tower_clears, stats.lifetime_tower_clears),
  ].filter(Boolean).join('');

  if (!rows) return null;

  return `<div style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:#fff;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;line-height:1.4;padding:8px">`+
    `<div style="font-weight:700;color:#0ff;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:13px">📊 ${modeLabel}</div>`+
    `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 1fr;gap:2px 6px;margin-bottom:3px;border-bottom:1px solid #444;padding-bottom:2px">`+
    `<div></div><div style="color:#0ff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600">${T.stats_col_session}</div><div style="color:#ffd700;font-size:11px;font-weight:600">${T.stats_col_lifetime}</div></div>`+
    `<div style="font-size:11px">${rows}</div>`+
    `</div>`;
}

    pointer-events:none;
    text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  `;
  return panel;
}

    increment: _statsIncrement,
    set: _statsSet,
    get: _statsGet,
    reset: _statsReset,
    startRefresh,
  };

                      if (typeof raw === 'number' && isFinite(raw) && raw > 0) secs = raw;
                      const endRaw = entry.endTime ?? entry.endsAt ?? entry.endAt;
                      if (typeof endRaw === 'number' && isFinite(endRaw) && endRaw > now) {
                          const endSecs = (endRaw - now) / 1000;
                          if (endSecs > secs) secs = endSecs;

                      dur = entry.duration ?? entry.lockdownDuration ?? 0;

      const { _ghostifyEnemy, _unghostifyEnemy, _updateCharTransparency, updateGhostEffect } = (() => {
          function _ghostifyEnemy(origin) {
              _eachMesh(origin, mi => {
                  _cloneMat(mi, _SYM_GHOST);
                  mi.material.blendType = W.pc.BLEND_NORMAL;
                  mi.material.opacity = 0.3;
                  mi.material.depthWrite = false;
                  mi.material.update();
              });
          }
          function _unghostifyEnemy(origin) {
              _eachMesh(origin, mi => { _restoreMat(mi, _SYM_GHOST); });
          }
          function _updateCharTransparency() {
              const shouldFade = _ghostActive || _feats.invisible;
              const opacity = !shouldFade ? 1.0 : (_feats.invisible ? INVIS_OPACITY : GHOST_OPACITY);
              const mis = _collectCharMeshes();
              if (!mis.length) return;
              for (const mi of mis) {
                  if (opacity < 1.0) {
                      _cloneMat(mi, _SYM_MAT);
                      mi.material.blendType = W.pc.BLEND_NORMAL;
                      mi.material.opacity = opacity;
                      mi.material.depthWrite = false;
                  } else {
                      _restoreMat(mi, _SYM_MAT);
                  }
                  mi.material.update();
              }
          }
          function updateGhostEffect() {
              const pt = _getPetTycoon();

              if (shouldGhost === _ghostActive) return;
              _ghostActive = shouldGhost;
              _updateCharTransparency();
          }
          return { _ghostifyEnemy, _unghostifyEnemy, _updateCharTransparency, updateGhostEffect };
