      const _xrayEntityData = new WeakMap();

      const { _xrayEnemy, _unxrayEnemy, _xrayAllEnemies, _clearAllXray, updateXrayEffect } = (() => {

          function _getPlayerRole(sessionId) {
              try {
                  const nm = _getNetworkManager();
                  const players = nm?.room?.state?.players;
                  if (!players) return null;
                  const p = players.get?.(sessionId);
                  if (!p) return null;
                  return p.isMurder === true ? 'murder' : 'civilian';
              } catch (e) { return null; }
          }

          function _raycastOccluded(origin, target, enemy) {
              try {
                  const rb = W.pc?.app?.systems?.rigidbody;
                  if (!rb) return true;
                  const dir = new W.pc.Vec3().sub2(target, origin);
                  const dist = dir.length();
                  if (dist < 0.01) return false;
                  dir.scale(1 / dist);
                  const start = new W.pc.Vec3().add2(origin, dir.clone().scale(0.3));
                  const end = new W.pc.Vec3().add2(start, dir.scale(dist + 2));
                  const hit = rb.raycastFirst(start, end);
                  if (!hit) return false;
                  let ent = hit.entity;
                  while (ent) {
                      if (ent === enemy) return false;
                      ent = ent.parent;
                  }
                  const hitDist = origin.distance(hit.point);
                  return hitDist < dist - 0.8;
              } catch (e) { return true; }
          }

          function _occlusionRatio(enemy) {
              try {
                  const cam = getCamera();
                  if (!cam) return 1;
                  const origin = cam.getPosition();
                  const base = enemy.getPosition();
                  if (!origin || !base) return 1;
                  const offsets = [
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0, 1.8, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0, 1.0, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0.3, 0.6, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(-0.3, 0.6, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0, 0.0, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0, -0.6, 0),
                      new W.pc.Vec3(0, -1.0, 0),
                  ];
                  let occluded = 0;
                  for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
                      const t = new W.pc.Vec3().add2(base, offsets[i]);
                      if (_raycastOccluded(origin, t, enemy)) occluded++;
                  }
                  return occluded / offsets.length;
              } catch (e) { return 1; }
          }

          function _makeXrayMaterial(role, opacity) {
              const mat = new W.pc.StandardMaterial();
              mat.depthTest = false;
              mat.depthWrite = false;
              mat.blendType = W.pc.BLEND_NORMAL;
              mat.opacity = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(0.85, opacity));
              if (role === 'murder') {
                  mat.diffuse = new W.pc.Color(1, 0.08, 0.08);
                  mat.emissive = new W.pc.Color(1.2, 0.05, 0.05);
              } else if (role === 'civilian') {
                  mat.diffuse = new W.pc.Color(0.08, 0.4, 1);
                  mat.emissive = new W.pc.Color(0.05, 0.3, 1.2);
              } else {
                  mat.diffuse = new W.pc.Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.08);
                  mat.emissive = new W.pc.Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.05);
              }
              mat.update();
              return mat;
          }

          function _xrayEnemy(entity) {
              const sid = entity.sessionId;
              const role = _getPlayerRole(sid);
              const ratio = _occlusionRatio(entity);
              if (ratio < 0.4) {
                  _unxrayEnemy(entity);
                  return;
              }
              let data = _xrayEntityData.get(entity);
              if (!data) {
                  data = { mat: null, role };
                  _xrayEntityData.set(entity, data);
              }
              const targetOpacity = 0.15 + ratio * 0.7;
              if (!data.mat || data.role !== role) {
                  if (data.mat) data.mat.destroy();
                  data.mat = _makeXrayMaterial(role, targetOpacity);
                  data.role = role;
                  const meshes = [];
                  _collectEntityMeshes(entity, meshes);
                  for (let i = 0; i < meshes.length; i++) {
                      const mi = meshes[i];
                      _saveOrigMat(mi, _SYM_XRAY);
                      mi.material = data.mat;
                  }
              } else if (Math.abs(data.mat.opacity - targetOpacity) > 0.05) {
                  data.mat.opacity = targetOpacity;
                  data.mat.update();
              }
          }

          function _unxrayEnemy(entity) {
              const data = _xrayEntityData.get(entity);
              const meshes = [];
              _collectEntityMeshes(entity, meshes);
              for (let i = 0; i < meshes.length; i++) {
                  _restoreMat(meshes[i], _SYM_XRAY);
              }
              if (data) {
                  if (data.mat) data.mat.destroy();
                  _xrayEntityData.delete(entity);
              }
          }

          function _xrayAllEnemies() {
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              if (!nm) return;
              const arr = nm.playerArray;
              if (!arr || !arr.length) return;
              const mySid = nm.sessionId;
              for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                  const enemy = arr[i];
                  if (!enemy) continue;
                  const sid = enemy.sessionId;
                  if (!sid || sid === mySid) continue;
                  _xrayEnemy(enemy);
              }
          }

          function _clearAllXray() {
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              if (!nm) return;
              const arr = nm.playerArray;
              if (!arr) return;
              for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                  _unxrayEnemy(arr[i]);
              }
              _xrayActive = false;
          }

          function updateXrayEffect() {
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              const rn = nm?.room?.name;
              const gm = nm?.gameMode;
              const inInfection = rn === 'Infection' || gm === 'Infection';
              const shouldXray = _feats.xrayInfection && inInfection;

              if (inInfection && _feats.xrayInfection) {
                  const scene = W.pc?.app?.scene;
                  if (scene && scene.fog) {
                      scene.fog.type = W.pc.FOG_NONE || 'none';
                  }
                  const cam = getCamera();
                  if (cam && cam.camera && cam.camera.farClip < 8000) {
                      try { cam.camera.farClip = 8000; } catch (e) {}
                  }
              }

              if (!shouldXray && _xrayActive) {
                  _clearAllXray();
                  return;
              }
              if (shouldXray && !_xrayActive) {
                  _xrayActive = true;
              }
              if (_xrayActive) {
                  _xrayAllEnemies();
              }
          }

          return { _xrayEnemy, _unxrayEnemy, _xrayAllEnemies, _clearAllXray, updateXrayEffect };

      const _proTipSentMsgs = new Set();
      let _lastProTipSendTime = 0;
      function _addNoise(s) {
          const capsR = Math.random();
          if (capsR < 0.02) { s = s.toUpperCase(); }
          else if (capsR < 0.42) { s = s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1); }
          else if (capsR < 0.48) {
              const w = s.split(' ');
              if (w.length > 1) {
                  const ri = (Math.random() * w.length | 0);
                  if (w[ri].length <= 6) w[ri] = w[ri].toUpperCase();
                  s = w.join(' ');
              }
          }
          const punctR = Math.random();
          if (punctR < 0.18) { } else if (punctR < 0.37) s += '.';
          else if (punctR < 0.45) s += '!';
          else if (punctR < 0.53) s += '?';
          else if (punctR < 0.58) s += '..';
          else if (punctR < 0.61) s += '...';
          if (Math.random() < 0.03 && s.length > 4) {
              const i = 1 + (Math.random() * (s.length - 2) | 0);
              if (s[i] !== ' ' && s[i-1] !== ' ' && s[i] !== s[i-1]) {
                  s = s.slice(0, i-1) + s[i] + s[i-1] + s.slice(i+1);
              }
          }
          if (Math.random() < 0.07) {
              const w = s.split(' ');
              const si = Math.random() * (w.length - 1) | 0;
              const word = w[si];
              if (word.length > 0 && word.length <= 5 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
                  w[si] = word + word.charAt(word.length-1);
              }
              s = w.join(' ');
          }
          if (Math.random() < 0.10) {
              const w = s.split(' ');
              if (w.length > 2) {
                  const ci = 1 + (Math.random() * (w.length - 2) | 0);
                  if (!/[.!?,]$/.test(w[ci-1]) && !/^[A-Z]/.test(w[ci])) {
                      w[ci-1] = w[ci-1] + ',';
                  }
                  s = w.join(' ');
              }
          }
          s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
          if (Math.random() < 0.08) {
              const sp = s.indexOf(' ', 1);
              if (sp > 0) s = s.slice(0, sp) + '  ' + s.slice(sp + 1);
          }
          if (Math.random() < 0.04 && !/\s$/.test(s)) s += ' ';
          if (Math.random() < 0.03) {
              const sp = s.indexOf(' ');
              if (sp > 0 && Math.random() < 0.5) s = s.slice(0, sp) + '.' + s.slice(sp + 1);
          }
          return s;
      }
      function _genProTip() {
          const t = _pick(_T);
          const subs = {};
          const assembled = t.replace(/[A-Z]/g, m => {
              const word = _pick(_P[m] || ['']);
              subs[m] = word;
              return word;
          });
          const final = _addNoise(assembled);
          return { template: t, subs, assembled, final };
      }
      function _trySendProTip() {
          if (!_feats.proTips) return;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (now - _proTipsCooldown < _PT_COOLDOWN) return;
          const room = _getRoom();
          if (!room) return;
          _proTipsCooldown = now;
          const rawSend = _rawSend(room);
          const delay = 2000 + Math.random() * 3000;
          setTimeout(() => {
              if (!_feats.proTips || !_getRoom()) return;
              const { template, subs, assembled, final: msg } = _genProTip();
              _proTipSentMsgs.add(msg);
              _lastProTipSendTime = Date.now();
              setTimeout(() => _proTipSentMsgs.delete(msg), 5000);
              rawSend(1, msg);
              _dbgLog('protip', 'sent', { msg, template, subs, assembled });
          }, delay);

      function _simulateKey(which, type) {
          const codes = { 87: ['KeyW','w'], 65: ['KeyA','a'], 83: ['KeyS','s'], 68: ['KeyD','d'], 32: ['Space',' '] };
          const c = codes[which];
          if (!c) return;

          if (cv) cv.dispatchEvent(ev); else window.dispatchEvent(ev);
          const pcs = getPlayer()?.script?.playerController;
          if (pcs?.touchInput) {
              if (type === 'keydown') {
                  if (which === 87) pcs.touchInput.z = -1;
                  if (which === 83) pcs.touchInput.z = 1;
                  if (which === 65) pcs.touchInput.x = 1;
                  if (which === 68) pcs.touchInput.x = -1;
              } else if (type === 'keyup') {
                  if (which === 87 || which === 83) pcs.touchInput.z = 0;
                  if (which === 65 || which === 68) pcs.touchInput.x = 0;
              }
          }
          _lastSimTouchZ = pcs?.touchInput?.z;
          _lastSimTouchX = pcs?.touchInput?.x;
      }

      function _isTouchInterfering() {
          const pcs = getPlayer()?.script?.playerController;
          if (!pcs?.touchInput) return false;
          const tz = pcs.touchInput.z;
          const tx = pcs.touchInput.x;
          if (tz === 0 && tx === 0) return false;
          if (_lastSimTouchZ !== 0 && Math.abs(tz - _lastSimTouchZ) > 0.01) return true;
          if (_lastSimTouchX !== 0 && Math.abs(tx - _lastSimTouchX) > 0.01) return true;
          if (_lastSimTouchZ === 0 && Math.abs(tz) > 0.01) return true;
          if (_lastSimTouchX === 0 && Math.abs(tx) > 0.01) return true;
          return false;
      }

      function _cameraVectors() {
          const pc = getPlayer()?.script?.playerController;
          if (!pc?.cameraController) return null;
          const yaw = pc.cameraController.eulers.x;
          const q = new W.pc.Quat().setFromEulerAngles(0, yaw, 0);
          const tf = new W.pc.Vec3();
          const tr = new W.pc.Vec3();
          q.transformVector(W.pc.Vec3.FORWARD, tf);
          q.transformVector(W.pc.Vec3.RIGHT, tr);
          return { fwd: tf, right: tr };
      }

      const { attackClosestEnemy, _refreshMyPetTokens } = (() => {
          let _lastAttackTime = 0;
          function _trackAttack(player, target, rawSend, dir, onDone) {
              const t0 = performance.now();
              let hit = false;
              let attacks = 0;
              let prevPos = null;
              const step = () => {
                  const ep = target.getPosition();
                  let aimX = ep.x, aimY = ep.y, aimZ = ep.z;
                  if (prevPos) {
                      const vx = ep.x - prevPos.x;
                      const vz = ep.z - prevPos.z;
                      aimX += vx * 6;
                      aimZ += vz * 6;
                  }
                  prevPos = { x: ep.x, y: ep.y, z: ep.z };
                  const d = Math.atan2(aimX - player.getPosition().x, aimZ - player.getPosition().z) * (180 / Math.PI);
                  teleport(player, vec3({ x: aimX, y: aimY, z: aimZ }));
                  rawSend('p', { x: aimX, y: aimY, z: aimZ, w: d });
                  const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
                  if (elapsed >= 50 && attacks < 3) { rawSend('attack', 'Baton'); attacks++; hit = true; }
                  if (elapsed < 300) { requestAnimationFrame(step); }
                  else { if (!hit) rawSend('attack', 'Baton'); onDone?.(); }
              };
              step();
          }
          function attackClosestEnemy() {
              _netGuard((room, rawSend) => {
              if (room.name !== 'PetTycoon') return;
              const now = Date.now();
              if (now - _lastAttackTime < 100) return;
              _lastAttackTime = now;
              const player = getPlayer();
              if (!player) return;
              const holder = _getEnemyHolder();
              if (!holder?.children?.length) {
                  _log('info', 'attack: no enemies found');
                  return;
              }
              const pPos = player.getPosition();
              let closest = null, closestDist = Infinity, closestName = 'Player', closestEntity = null;
              for (const enemy of holder.children) {
                  if (typeof _isImmortalEntity === 'function' && _isImmortalEntity(enemy)) continue;
                  const name = _getEnemyName(enemy);
                  const ePos = enemy.getPosition();
                  const d = pPos.distance(ePos);
                  if (d < closestDist) {
                      closestDist = d;
                      closest = ePos;
                      closestEntity = enemy;
                      closestName = name || 'Player';
                  }
              }
              if (!closest || !closestEntity) return;
              backPos = capturePos(player);
              const myPos = player.getPosition();
              const dir = Math.atan2(closest.x - myPos.x, closest.z - myPos.z) * (180 / Math.PI);
              _trackAttack(player, closestEntity, rawSend, dir, () => {
                  _log('info', 'attack: hit ' + closestName + ' (' + Math.floor(closestDist) + 'm)');
                  _dbgLog('combat', 'attack-hit', { target: closestName, dist: Math.floor(closestDist) });
              });
              });
          }
          function _refreshMyPetTokens() {
              const now = Date.now();
              if (now - _myPetTokensTime < 10000 && _myPetTokens.size > 0) return;
              const nm = _getNetworkManager();
              const room = nm?.room;
              const myId = room?.sessionId;
              if (!myId) return;
              const root = W.pc?.app?.root;
              if (!root) return;
              const heldByThieves = new Set();
              if (room.state?.players) {
                  room.state.players.forEach((p, sid) => {
                      if (sid !== myId && p.isHoldingPet && p.holdingPetToken) heldByThieves.add(p.holdingPetToken);
                  });
              }
              const fresh = new Set();
              root.find(e => {
                  if (!e.script) return false;
                  for (const k of Object.keys(e.script)) {
                      const s = e.script[k];
                      if (s?.basePets && s.basePets.size > 0) {
                          s.basePets.forEach((pet, token) => {
                              if (pet?.owner === myId) fresh.add(token);
                          });
                          return true;
                      }
                  }
                  return false;
              });
              for (const t of _myPetTokens) {
                  if (heldByThieves.has(t)) fresh.add(t);
              }
              _myPetTokens = fresh;
              _myPetTokensTime = now;
          }
          return { attackClosestEnemy, _refreshMyPetTokens };
      })();

          function _ensureMesBanner(app, om) {

              try { updateGhostEffect(); } catch (e) { _dbgLog('tick', 'ghostEffect-err', { err: e.message }, 'error'); }
          }
          try { updateXrayEffect(); } catch (e) { _dbgLog('tick', 'xrayEffect-err', { err: e.message }, 'error'); }
          if (_nativeHud?._root && !_nativeHud._root.parent) {
              _nativeHud = createNativeHUD();
              if (_nativeHud) { Object.assign(hud, _nativeHud); _log('setup', 'native HUD recovered'); }
              else { for (const k of Object.keys(hud)) hud[k] = null; }
          }
          const gameSettingsOpen = W.pc?.isGamePaused && _overlayMgr?.currentPauseCategory === 'SettingsCategory';
          const nativeVisible = _nativeHud?._root?.enabled && _nativeHud._root.parent;
          if (hud.hudRoot) hud.hudRoot.style.display = gameSettingsOpen ? 'none' : (nativeVisible ? 'none' : 'flex');
          if (_nativeHud?._root) _nativeHud._root.enabled = !gameSettingsOpen;
          if (hud.carryTimer) {
              const pt = _getPetTycoon();
              const holding = !!(pt?.isHoldingPet);
              const isSteal = !!_getBasesManager()?.activeBases;
              if (holding && isSteal) {
                  if (!hud.carryTimer._start) hud.carryTimer._start = Date.now();
                  hud.carryTimer.style.display = '';
                  hud.carryTimer.textContent = '\u23F1 ' + ((Date.now() - hud.carryTimer._start) / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's';
              } else {
                  if (hud.carryTimer._start) hud.carryTimer._start = 0;
                  hud.carryTimer.style.display = 'none';
                  if (_carryTune.playing) _stopCarryTune();
              }
          }
      }

      function _tickFps(frameDtMs) {
          _debugFpsAccumFrames++;
          _debugFpsAccumMs += frameDtMs;
          if (_debugFpsAccumMs >= 1000) {
              _debugFps = Math.round((_debugFpsAccumFrames * 1000) / _debugFpsAccumMs);
              _debugFpsAccumFrames = 0;
              _debugFpsAccumMs = 0;
              return true;
          }
          return false;
      }

      function _tickCoordsOverlay(fpsDirty) {
          const overlayNow = Date.now();
          if (_feats.showCoords) {
              const playerPos = getPlayer()?.getPosition?.();
              if (overlayNow >= _coordsOverlayNextAt || fpsDirty) {
                  _coordsOverlayNextAt = overlayNow + 100;
                  _syncCoordsOverlay(playerPos);
              }
          } else if (_feats.showFps && fpsDirty) _syncCoordsOverlay();

      }

      function _tickTargetInfo() {
          const lookNow = Date.now();
          if (lookNow < _targetInfoNextAt) return;
          _targetInfoNextAt = lookNow + 300;
          try {
              const cam = getCamera();
              if (!cam) return;
              const origin = cam.getPosition();
              const fwd = cam.forward;
              const rb = W.pc?.app?.systems?.rigidbody;
              if (!rb) return;
              const end = new W.pc.Vec3(origin.x + fwd.x * 500, origin.y + fwd.y * 500, origin.z + fwd.z * 500);
              const hit = rb.raycastFirst(origin, end);
              if (hit?.entity) {
                  const hitEnt = hit.entity;
                  const parts = [];
                  let e = hitEnt;
                  const chain = [];
                  while (e) { chain.unshift(e.name || '?'); e = e.parent; }
                  parts.push(chain.join('/'));
                  const tags = hitEnt.tags;
                  if (tags && tags.size) parts.push('[' + [...tags].join(',') + ']');
                  if (hitEnt.model?.meshInstances?.length) {
                      const mi = hitEnt.model.meshInstances[0];
                      if (mi.mesh?.name) parts.push('mesh:' + mi.mesh.name);
                      const mat = mi.material;
                      if (mat) {
                          if (mat.name) parts.push('mat:' + mat.name);
                          const texNames = [];
                          if (mat.diffuseMap?.name) texNames.push('dif:' + mat.diffuseMap.name);
                          if (mat.emissiveMap?.name) texNames.push('emi:' + mat.emissiveMap.name);
                          if (texNames.length) parts.push(texNames.join(' '));
                          if (mat.opacity != null && mat.opacity !== 1) parts.push('a:' + mat.opacity.toFixed(2));
                      }
                  }
                  _targetInfoText = parts.join(' | ');
              } else {
                  _targetInfoText = _tickTargetInfoFallback(origin, fwd);
              }
          } catch (_) { _targetInfoText = ''; }
          if (_targetInfoText) _syncCoordsOverlay();
      }

      function _tickTargetInfoFallback(origin, fwd) {
          const root = W.pc?.app?.root;
          if (!root) return '';
          const dirLen = Math.sqrt(fwd.x*fwd.x+fwd.y*fwd.y+fwd.z*fwd.z);
          const dx = fwd.x/dirLen, dy = fwd.y/dirLen, dz = fwd.z/dirLen;
          let bestDist = Infinity;
          let bestEnt = null;
          const _worldPos = (ent) => {
              const wt = ent.getWorldTransform?.();
              if (wt?.data) return {x:wt.data[12], y:wt.data[13], z:wt.data[14]};
              const p = ent.getPosition();
              return {x:p.x, y:p.y, z:p.z};
          };
          const _traverse = (ent) => {
              const hasModel = ent.model?.meshInstances?.length && ent.model.enabled;
              const hasElem = ent.element?.enabled && (ent.element.type === 'image' || ent.element.type === 'text');
              if (hasModel || hasElem) {
                  const wp = _worldPos(ent);
                  const vx = wp.x - origin.x, vy = wp.y - origin.y, vz = wp.z - origin.z;
                  const t = vx*dx + vy*dy + vz*dz;
                  if (t > 0 && t < 500) {
                      const cx = origin.x + dx*t, cy = origin.y + dy*t, cz = origin.z + dz*t;
                      const d = Math.sqrt((cx-wp.x)*(cx-wp.x)+(cy-wp.y)*(cy-wp.y)+(cz-wp.z)*(cz-wp.z));
                      if (d < 3 && t < bestDist) { bestDist = t; bestEnt = ent; }
                  }
              }
              const children = ent.children;
              if (children) for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) _traverse(children[i]);
          };
          _traverse(root);
          if (!bestEnt) return '';
          const parts2 = [];
          let e2 = bestEnt;
          const chain2 = [];
          while (e2) { chain2.unshift(e2.name || '?'); e2 = e2.parent; }
          parts2.push(chain2.join('/'));
          const tags2 = bestEnt.tags;
          if (tags2 && tags2.size) parts2.push('[' + [...tags2].join(',') + ']');
          if (bestEnt.model?.meshInstances?.length) {
              const mi2 = bestEnt.model.meshInstances[0];
              if (mi2.mesh?.name) parts2.push('mesh:' + mi2.mesh.name);
              const mat2 = mi2.material;
              if (mat2) {
                  if (mat2.name) parts2.push('mat:' + mat2.name);
                  const tn2 = [];
                  if (mat2.diffuseMap?.name) tn2.push('dif:' + mat2.diffuseMap.name);
                  if (mat2.emissiveMap?.name) tn2.push('emi:' + mat2.emissiveMap.name);
                  if (tn2.length) parts2.push(tn2.join(' '));
                  if (mat2.opacity != null && mat2.opacity !== 1) parts2.push('a:' + mat2.opacity.toFixed(2));
              }
          }
          if (bestEnt.element?.enabled) {
              parts2.push('el:' + (bestEnt.element.type || '?'));
              if (bestEnt.element.textureAsset?.name) parts2.push('tex:' + bestEnt.element.textureAsset.name);
              if (bestEnt.element.text) parts2.push('txt:' + bestEnt.element.text);
          }
          return parts2.join(' | ');
      }

      function _tickCuddle(player, kcc, now) {
          if (!_cuddle.active || !_cuddle.target || !_feats.cuddleFollow) return;
          var tPos = _cuddle.target.getPosition?.();
          if (!tPos || !isFinite(tPos.x) || !isFinite(tPos.z)) {
              _cuddle.active = false;
              _cuddle.target = null;
              _cuddle.walking = false;
              if (_cuddle.noclipWasOff) { _cuddle.noclipWasOff = false; _feats.noclip = false; hookNoclip(); }
              _cuddle.lastSnap = 0;
              _cuddle.stationaryTicks = 0;
              _cuddle.firstOrient = false;
              _cuddle.idleStopped = false;
              _cuddle.firstSnapDone = false;
              _releaseAllSimKeys();
              _dbgLog('cuddle', 'target-lost', null, 'debug');
              return;
          }
          if (_fly.active) { _fly.active = false; if (typeof flyOff === 'function') flyOff(kcc); }
          kcc._grounded = true;
          kcc.gravity = GRAVITY;
          if (!_feats.noclip) { _cuddle.noclipWasOff = true; _feats.noclip = true; hookNoclip(); }
          _cuddle.walking = true;
          var cam = player.script?.playerController?.cameraController;
          if (!_cuddle.prev) { _cuddle.prev = { x: tPos.x, z: tPos.z }; _cuddle.stationaryTicks = 0; }
          var rdx = tPos.x - _cuddle.prev.x;
          var rdz = tPos.z - _cuddle.prev.z;
          var tDist = Math.hypot(rdx, rdz);
          if (tDist < 0.05) { _cuddle.stationaryTicks++; }
          else { _cuddle.stationaryTicks = 0; _cuddle.lastRdx = rdx; _cuddle.lastRdz = rdz; }
          var pPos = player.getPosition();
          var cDist = Math.hypot(tPos.x - pPos.x, tPos.z - pPos.z);
          var effDist = Math.abs(cDist - 0.3);
          var sinceSnap = now - _cuddle.lastSnap;
          var doSnap = (_cuddle.stationaryTicks >= 3 && effDist > 0.5) || (sinceSnap > 1000 && effDist > 0.5) || (!_cuddle.firstSnapDone && sinceSnap > 1000);
          var orientRdx, orientRdz;
          if (!_cuddle.firstOrient || doSnap) {
              if (effDist > 0.5) {
                  orientRdx = tPos.x - pPos.x;
                  orientRdz = tPos.z - pPos.z;
              } else if (_cuddle.lastRdx || _cuddle.lastRdz) {
                  orientRdx = _cuddle.lastRdx;
                  orientRdz = _cuddle.lastRdz;
              } else {
                  var tEulers = _cuddle.target.getEulerAngles?.();
                  if (tEulers) {
                      var tr = tEulers.y * Math.PI / 180;
                      orientRdx = Math.sin(tr);
                      orientRdz = Math.cos(tr);
                  }
              }
              if (orientRdx || orientRdz) {
                  var yaw = Math.atan2(orientRdx, orientRdz) * (180 / Math.PI);
                  if (cam) cam.eulers.x = yaw;
                  var pctrl = player.script?.playerController;
                  if (pctrl) {
                      pctrl.direction = yaw * Math.PI / 180;
                      if (pctrl.characterOriginEntity) pctrl.characterOriginEntity.setLocalEulerAngles(0, yaw, 0);
                  }
              }
              if (!_cuddle.firstOrient) _cuddle.firstOrient = true;
          }
          if (doSnap) {
              _tickCuddleSnap(player, kcc, tPos, orientRdx, orientRdz, now);
              _cuddle.lastSnap = now;
              _cuddle.stationaryTicks = 0;
              _cuddle.idleStopped = false;
              _cuddle.firstSnapDone = true;
          }
          _tickCuddleAnim(player, now, effDist);
          _cuddle.prev = { x: tPos.x, z: tPos.z };
      }

      function _tickCuddleSnap(player, kcc, tPos, orientRdx, orientRdz, now) {
          var oldPPos = player.getPosition();
          var oldPos = { x: oldPPos.x, y: oldPPos.y, z: oldPPos.z };
          var snapX = tPos.x, snapZ = tPos.z;
          if (orientRdx || orientRdz) {
              var oLen = Math.hypot(orientRdx, orientRdz) || 1;
              snapX = tPos.x - (orientRdx / oLen) * 0.3;
              snapZ = tPos.z - (orientRdz / oLen) * 0.3;
          }
          teleport(player, { x: snapX, y: tPos.y, z: snapZ });
          if (kcc && kcc.teleport) { kcc.teleport(snapX, tPos.y, snapZ); }
          else if (kcc) { kcc._posX = snapX; kcc._posY = tPos.y; kcc._posZ = snapZ; kcc._velX = 0; kcc._velZ = 0; }
          var pctrl3 = player.script?.playerController;
          if (pctrl3) { pctrl3.lastBroadcast = 0; }
          _cuddle.interp = { fromX: oldPos.x, fromY: oldPos.y, fromZ: oldPos.z, toX: snapX, toY: tPos.y, toZ: snapZ, start: now, dur: 1000 };
          if (_cuddle.wasRunning) {
              var pctrl4 = pctrl3;
              if (pctrl4) { pctrl4.isRunning = false; pctrl4.lastRunningBoolean = true; }
              try { W.pc.app.fire('NetworkManager:Send', 'animSetBooleans', [{ name: 'Running', value: false }]); } catch (_) {}
              _cuddle.wasRunning = false;
          }
      }

      function _tickCuddleAnim(player, now, effDist) {
          if (_cuddle.wasRunning) {
              if (effDist < 0.5 && now - _cuddle.lastSnap > 1500) {
                  var pctrl5 = player.script?.playerController;
                  if (pctrl5) { pctrl5.isRunning = false; pctrl5.lastRunningBoolean = true; }
                  try { W.pc.app.fire('NetworkManager:Send', 'animSetBooleans', [{ name: 'Running', value: false }]); } catch (_) {}
                  _cuddle.wasRunning = false;
                  _cuddle.idleStopped = true;
              } else {
                  var pctrl5b = player.script?.playerController;
                  if (pctrl5b) { pctrl5b.isRunning = true; pctrl5b.lastRunningBoolean = false; }
              }
          } else if (!_cuddle.idleStopped && now - _cuddle.lastSnap > 50 && now - _cuddle.lastSnap < 1500) {
              var pctrl6 = player.script?.playerController;
              if (pctrl6) { pctrl6.isRunning = true; pctrl6.lastRunningBoolean = false; }
              try { W.pc.app.fire('NetworkManager:Send', 'animSetBooleans', [{ name: 'Running', value: true }]); } catch (_) {}
              _cuddle.wasRunning = true;
          }
          if (player.script?.playerController?.characterAnimator) {
              player.script.playerController.characterAnimator.setBoolean('Running', _cuddle.wasRunning);
          }
      }

      function _tickCarryState(player, pc, kcc) {
          const currentRoom = getCachedRoomName() || _getNetworkManager()?.room?.name || '';
          const inStealRoom = currentRoom === 'PetTycoon';
          const inWavesRoom = currentRoom === 'EscapeTsunami';
          const ptCarry = inStealRoom ? !!_getPetTycoon()?.isHoldingPet : false;
          const etCarry = inWavesRoom ? !!_getEscapeTsunami()?.isHoldingPet : false;
          const inSteal = inStealRoom && !!_getBasesManager()?.activeBases;
          if (inSteal && ptCarry) {
              if (!_carry.forcedInvis) {
                  _carry.forcedInvis = true;
                  _carry.forcedInvisPrev = !!_feats.invisible;
                  _carry.forcedInvisSuppressed = false;
              }
              if (!_carry.forcedInvisSuppressed && !_feats.invisible) {
                  _feats.invisible = true;
                  _toggleInvisible(true);
                  _updateInvisEffect(true);
              }
              if (hud.forcedInvis) hud.forcedInvis.classList.toggle('on', _feats.invisible);
          } else if (_carry.forcedInvis) {
              const restoreInvis = _carry.forcedInvisPrev;
              _carry.forcedInvis = false;
              _carry.forcedInvisPrev = false;
              _carry.forcedInvisSuppressed = false;
              if (_feats.invisible !== restoreInvis) {
                  _feats.invisible = restoreInvis;
                  _toggleInvisible(restoreInvis);
                  _updateInvisEffect(restoreInvis);
              }
              if (hud.forcedInvis) hud.forcedInvis.classList.toggle('on', _feats.invisible);
          }
          if (inSteal && ptCarry) {
              if (!_carry.forcedNoclip) {
                  _carry.forcedNoclip = true;
                  _carry.forcedNoclipPrev = !!_feats.noclip;
              }
              if (!_feats.noclip) { _feats.noclip = true; hookNoclip(); }
              if (hud.forcedNoclip) hud.forcedNoclip.classList.add('on');
          } else if (_carry.forcedNoclip) {
              const restoreNoclip = _carry.forcedNoclipPrev;
              _carry.forcedNoclip = false;
              _carry.forcedNoclipPrev = false;
              if (_feats.noclip !== restoreNoclip) { _feats.noclip = restoreNoclip; hookNoclip(); }
              if (hud.forcedNoclip) hud.forcedNoclip.classList.toggle('on', _feats.noclip);
          }
          if (_feats.carryNormalize && (ptCarry || etCarry)) {
              if (pc?.isSlowedSpeed) pc.isSlowedSpeed = false;
              if (ptCarry && pc?.isHolding) pc.isHolding = false;
              if (!_cuddle.active) {
                  const targetSpeed = inSteal ? Math.min(SPEED_DEFAULT, 9) : SPEED_DEFAULT;
                  if (kcc.speed !== targetSpeed) kcc.speed = targetSpeed;
              }
          }
      }

      function _tickHudButtons() {
          const _lazyRoom = getCachedRoomName() || _getNetworkManager()?.room?.name || '';
          const _lazySteal = _lazyRoom === 'PetTycoon' && !!_getBasesManager()?.activeBases;
          if (hud.fly)  { hud.fly.classList.toggle('on', _fly.active); hud.fly.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.fly); }
          if (hud.mobileFlyToggle) hud.mobileFlyToggle.classList.toggle('on', _fly.active);
          if (hud.spr)  hud.spr.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.sprint);
          if (hud.home) hud.home.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.waypoints);
          if (hud.go)   hud.go.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.waypoints);
          if (hud.back) hud.back.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.waypoints);
          if (hud.slots) { const n = slots.filter(Boolean).length; hud.slots.textContent = `SLOTS ${n}/10`; hud.slots.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.waypoints); }
          if (hud.tp)   { hud.tp.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.cuddle); hud.tp.classList.toggle('on', !!panels.plist?.classList.contains('open')); }
          if (hud.petsBtn) { hud.petsBtn.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.pets); hud.petsBtn.classList.toggle('on', !!panels.pets?.classList.contains('open')); }
          if (hud.snipeBtn) { hud.snipeBtn.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.snipe); hud.snipeBtn.classList.toggle('on', _sc().active || !!panels.snipe?.classList.contains('open')); }
          if (panels.snipe?.classList.contains('open')) _syncSnipePanel?.();
          if (hud.invis) { hud.invis.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.invis); hud.invis.classList.toggle('on', _feats.invisible); }
          if (hud.cfg)  { hud.cfg.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.settings); hud.cfg.classList.toggle('on', !!panels.settings?.classList.contains('open')); }
          if (hud.help) { hud.help.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.help); hud.help.classList.toggle('on', !!panels.dialog?.classList.contains('open')); }
          if (hud.prv)  { hud.prv.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.prv); }
          const inTower = _lazyRoom === 'TowerParkour';
          if (hud.tc) { hud.tc.classList.toggle('disabled', !inTower); if (_nativeHud?.tc?._native?.btn) _nativeHud.tc._native.btn.enabled = inTower; if (hud.carryTimer) hud.carryTimer.style.display = inTower ? '' : 'none'; }
          if (hud.lock) {
              if (_feats.autoLock && _lazySteal) {
                  const lockBtn = getLockBtn();
                  if (lockBtn) {
                      const timeLeft = lockBtn.lockdownTimeLeft || 0;
                      const isActive = lockBtn.isLockdownActive || false;
                      hud.lock.classList.toggle('on', isActive && timeLeft > 0);
                      hud.lock.textContent = (isActive && timeLeft > 0) ? `\ud83d\udd12 ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}s` : `\ud83d\udd13 ${T.lock_unlocked}`;
                  }
              } else if (!_feats.autoLock && _lazySteal) {
                  hud.lock.textContent = `\ud83d\udd13 ${T.lock_off}`;
                  hud.lock.classList.remove('on');
              }
              hud.lock.classList.toggle('disabled', !_shows.autoLock || !_lazySteal);
          }
      }

      function _tickFly(kcc, now) {
          if (!_fly.active) return;
          if (kcc._grounded && now - _fly.startTime > 500) { flyOff(kcc, false); return; }
          if (kcc.gravity !== 0) kcc.gravity = 0;
          _fly.velY = kcc._velY;
          const flySpeedCap = SPEED_DEFAULT;
          if (_fly.up) {
              if (_fly.velY < 0) _fly.velY = 0;
              _fly.velY = flySpeedCap;
          } else if (_fly.down) {
              if (_fly.velY > 0) _fly.velY = 0;
              _fly.velY = -flySpeedCap;
          } else {
              _fly.velY = 0;
          }
          kcc._velY = _fly.velY;
      }

      function _tickMid(player, pc, kcc, now) {
          if (_snipe.freezeStealActive) {
              if (_snipe.freezeUntil > 0 && now >= _snipe.freezeUntil) {
                  _snipe.freezeStealActive = false;
                  _snipe.freezeStartedAt = 0;
              } else if (_snipe.freezeStartedAt > 0 && now - _snipe.freezeStartedAt > 3500) {
                  _snipe.freezeUntil = 0;
                  _snipe.freezeStealActive = false;
                  _snipe.freezeStartedAt = 0;
              }
          }
          if (pc?.isDied) { pc.isDied = false; }
          _tickCuddle(player, kcc, now);
          _tickCarryState(player, pc, kcc);
      }

      function _tick() {
          requestAnimationFrame(_tick);
          _tickN++;
          const mid = (_tickN & 3) === 0;
          const slowEvery = _debugFps > 0 ? (_debugFps < 40 ? 18 : _debugFps < 50 ? 14 : 12) : 12;
          const slow = (_tickN % slowEvery === 0);
          const lazy = (_tickN % 32 === 0);
          const now = Date.now();

          if (slow) _tickSlow();

          const player = getPlayer();
          if (!player) return;
          const kcc = getKcc(player);
          if (!kcc) return;

          if (W.pc?.isMobile) {
              var kb = W.pc.app?.keyboard;
              var pcc = getPC(player);
              if (kb && pcc?.touchInput) {
                  var z = 0, x = 0;
                  if (kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_W) || kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_UP)) z = -1;
                  if (kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_S) || kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_DOWN)) z = 1;
                  if (kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_A) || kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_LEFT)) x = 1;
                  if (kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_D) || kb.isPressed(W.pc.KEY_RIGHT)) x = -1;
                  if (z !== 0 || x !== 0) {
                      pcc.touchInput.z = z; pcc.touchInput.x = x;
                      pcc._kbActive = true;
                  } else if (pcc._kbActive) {
                      pcc.touchInput.z = 0; pcc.touchInput.x = 0;
                      pcc._kbActive = false;
                  }
                  if (kb.wasPressed(W.pc.KEY_SPACE)) W.pc.app?.fire('Player:Jump');
              }
          }

          const frameNow = performance.now();
          const frameDtMs = Math.max(1, frameNow - _debugPrevFrameAt);
          _debugPrevFrameAt = frameNow;
          const fpsDirty = _tickFps(frameDtMs);
          _tickCoordsOverlay(fpsDirty);

          {
              const lr = $('ml-target-reticle');
              if (lr) {
                  const want = _feats.showTargetInfo ? 'block' : 'none';
                  if (lr.style.display !== want) lr.style.display = want;
              }
          }

          if (_feats.showTargetInfo) _tickTargetInfo();
          if (_feats.walkUpWalls && kcc._grounded && kcc._velY !== 0) kcc._velY = 0;
          try { _hookFpv(); } catch (e) {}

          if (mid) {
              const pc = getPC(player);
              _tickMid(player, pc, kcc, now);
          }

          if (lazy) _tickHudButtons();

          _tickFly(kcc, now);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(_tick);

      (function _schedPtRand() {
          setTimeout(() => { _trySendProTip(); _schedPtRand(); }, 30000 + Math.random() * 150000);
      })();

  })();
